birth_time_confidence.collection_facts: Array facts are internal metadata and do not support scalar eq or in predicates.
birth_time_confidence.public: Select only the localized explanation from shared/confidence/copy.yaml.
birth_time_confidence.record: Persist tier, rectified and withheld IDs per bound reading. Omitted evidence is unknown.

conditions.single_leaf: Wrap one typed fact predicate in an all list.

SCHEMA.yaml.exceptions: Store cancellations here with a when predicate, a cancel or soften effect, and a reason.

jaimini_entries.projection: Render only the reviewed locale copy. Scheme, rank, karaka identity, chart frame, pada steps, aspect pairs, intervention counts, titles and source evidence are administrative.

kp_entries.projection: Only render the localized reflection after evaluation. Keep titles, cusp degrees, numbered intervals, house groups, ruling roles and significator chains in administrative evidence.

life_area_summaries.discovery: Follow summary_profile relative to an area's reading.yaml.
life_area_summaries.feeds: Resolve the five lists to existing Vedic rule IDs. Houses and karakas describe the natal theme; a stable relevant varga can corroborate it. A placement definition alone supplies no direction.
life_area_summaries.render: Render the selected tone's user_text alongside the existing matched area reasons. Resolve each locale field separately. Always append the health profile's doctor line to its summary; across health slots show only everyday wellbeing and routines.
life_area_summaries.selection: Use only approved, matched evidence from the person's chart. Establish a natal theme before selecting a tone. Use the active or named upcoming dasha to time it and a dated transit to refine that period. Withhold unsupported timing and omit the summary when natal evidence is missing.
life_area_summaries.tones: Use life-areas/tone.yaml after the conflict ladder and final birth-time cap. A transit alone cannot establish or reverse a natal theme. Apply matched exceptions before synthesis.

life_areas.assignments: Tag every clearly applicable area using its catalogue key.
life_areas.empty: Use [] for an area-neutral definition or a rule whose area depends on the specific planet, house or activity supplied at runtime.

localized_copy.authoring: Supply nonblank strings for required locales. Omit planned keys until their text is available.
localized_copy.resolution: Resolve each field separately. Use the requested locale when present, otherwise use that field’s English text.

numerology_checks.presentation: A standalone numeric reflection is Steady. The fit tone requires approved, matched independent evidence under the parent recipe. Missing evidence is limited. Display only the localized tone and localized reflection. Never propose a name or number change, a purchase, or a financial outcome.
numerology_checks.privacy: Compute identifiers locally in memory. Keep raw mobile and vehicle inputs out of logs, prompts and stored traces. Show arithmetic only in the admin/tester view; do not send it to the public renderer.
numerology_checks.reductions: Use the selected system throughout a named metric. Bind raw compound meanings only to the unmodified Chaldean sum in the documented range. Bind a Pythagorean master meaning only to a retained metric result.

palmistry_guided_entries.routing: Bind one confirmed choice on its recorded physical hand. Use its hand-specific entry once. Older undifferentiated observations retain their original IDs.

period_and_yoga_bindings.modulation: Resolve the shared lord and pair note sets in vedic/dashas/vimshottari/modulation.yaml for each named period. Upcoming records link to existing transit predicates.
period_and_yoga_bindings.sensitive: An admin-only rule has a null public key and no reading, translation, alias or consumer route.
period_and_yoga_bindings.yoga: Every individual yoga references the shared activation record, binds the actual grahas of its formation, applies exceptions, then the participant grade and period gates.

reading_evidence.area_strength: Each declared life_area has one relevance. Core is directly addressed, related contributes supporting context, incidental is a peripheral association. Area-neutral rules use an empty map.
reading_evidence.runtime: The stored direction is generic. At KB-36 rung 3 use the chart's functional polarity for evidence about a specific graha's lordship. A context-only observation never anchors tone. See shared/explain/tone-contribution.yaml.

time_scope.transit: moving chart contact or timed overlay

reading_evidence.visibility: Internal metadata on every reading rule, including source aliases.

safe_remedies.display: Show the localized Traditional practice label, optional status and localized text. Use only free participation and freely available materials.
safe_remedies.fasting: Offer only as an explicitly selected existing practice for adults who know it is safe for them. Omit from health readings. Quiet reflection is available in the same copy.
safe_remedies.legacy: Inline entries also retain the free boolean for existing callers.
safe_remedies.link: Each catalogue practice links to a graha or house rule. Practices are optional traditional reflections and are never prerequisites for a reading.
safe_remedies.temple_visit: Optional, only when accessible without an offering or fee.

tarot_card_entries.conventions: Aces have elemental roots; pages have polar quadrants; other courts use the specified rank crosswalk. Element tags for planetary trumps are editorial. No birth chart inference from the draw.
tarot_card_entries.public: Localized glossary display label when specified, otherwise canonical RWS title, position prompt, localized tone and user_text; include the shared reflection footer. The title is a card identifier. Fear-word checks apply to interpretive text in every locale.

SCHEMA.yaml.traditions_differ: A low-confidence or disputed entry records the profile and the point of disagreement.

vastu_layout_entries.projection: Resolve the localized tone and the matched room's user_text independently using the existing locale fallback. Render only the unit's observed rooms and reversible suggestions.

vedic_area_varga_entries.scope: Topic readings use a typed condition for the bound factor; calculation entries retain the varga method block. Only MVP topic readings feed synthesis.

vedic_ashtakavarga_entries.input: Raw prastara is indexed by target graha, contributor and sidereal sign. Each supportive mark contributes one.
vedic_ashtakavarga_entries.public_projection: Render only localized qualitative text. Keep offset tables, contributor bits, sign counts, reductions and pinda out of public evidence.
vedic_ashtakavarga_entries.reduction: Preserve raw BAV and SAV. Apply the named occupancy and weight profiles only to the separate reduced rows.

vedic_dosha_entries.evaluation: Preserve natal formation separately from any relief, pair-only adjustment or timed interval.
vedic_dosha_entries.public_label: The four sensitive labels (shrapit, guru-chandal, pitru, grahan) use the localized public_label shared with their glossary entry. Traditional titles are staff evidence.
vedic_dosha_entries.reference_paths: Matching and transit entries link to their governing KB tables using kb-relative paths.

vedic_house_entries.bhavat_bhavam: Count N houses inclusively from house N, wrapping after twelve.
vedic_house_entries.body_convention: Kalapurusha sequence by ordinal house, irrespective of the occupying sign.

vedic_house_lord_entries.chart: Use the classical ruler of the source house sign in the natal whole-sign chart. Bind modifiers and candidate associations to the same lords and chart.
vedic_house_lord_entries.life_areas: Deduplicated union of both KB-04 houses.
vedic_house_lord_entries.related_rules: Evaluate each yoga separately. Raja and dhana require distinct eligible lords actually joined or exchanged in this profile. Exchanges require reciprocal occupation and distinct grahas.

vedic_nakshatra_entries.coordinates: Exact absolute sidereal arcminutes from Aries. Start inclusive and end exclusive. Normalize 360 degrees to zero before lookup.
vedic_nakshatra_entries.padas: Four successive 200-arcminute quarters, each binding its natal rasi and its D9 sign.

vedic_planet_entries.directional_strength: Peak house identifies the angle for maximum dig bala. Exact strength depends on angular distance.
vedic_planet_entries.functional_nature: For each whole-sign Lagna list houses owned. The strict single-graha yogakaraka flag requires ownership of both an angle (4, 7 or 10) and a trine (5 or 9). Nodes rule no houses in this profile.
vedic_planet_entries.natural_friendships: Directed natal relationships from the selected graha to the other six classical grahas. Keep temporary relationships separate.
vedic_planet_entries.nodes: Empty dignity tables and unassigned friendships and dig bala denote a deliberate doctrine choice.
vedic_planet_entries.own_sign_degrees: Sign membership spans 0 inclusive to 30 exclusive. Retain overlapping dignity flags and use the KB-01 degree limits for moolatrikona.

vedic_planets_in_houses.dig_bala: Match the KB-02 peak house. Calculating a strength value requires angular distance. Nodes are unassigned.
vedic_planets_in_houses.reference: Whole-sign natal house counted from a stable Lagna.
vedic_planets_in_houses.related_placement: Treat this entry and the linked vedic.houses placement as one piece of evidence.
vedic_planets_in_houses.related_rules: Optional top-level list of separate rules to consult. Each rule evaluates its own conditions.

vedic_planets_in_signs.cancellation: A debility exception references a candidate rule and applies only to the same selected graha.
vedic_planets_in_signs.degree_sensitive: Retain the KB-01/02 limits for moolatrikona and own sign, and the exact peak for exaltation or debilitation. A sign-only match cannot establish an exact degree state.
vedic_planets_in_signs.sign_class: Sign-level exaltation, debilitation or ownership takes precedence over the natural relationship to the ruler. Unassigned nodal dignity is disputed.

vedic_prashna_entries.public: Localized question reflection, eligible leaning with reasons, and optional review window.
vedic_prashna_entries.restricted: Health uses the clinician referral. Legal requests use the lawyer referral. Legal house study and the advanced Kerala observation workflow are admin-only.

vedic_saturn_transit_labels.projection: Render localized copy only. Titles, phase names, identifiers, fact chains and timing evidence are administrative metadata.

vedic_shadbala_entries.public_copy: Select a complete locale map from the reviewed qualitative phrase list in vedic/strength/shadbala/components.yaml. Do not interpolate any input, component, threshold or result into public text.
vedic_shadbala_entries.units: Sixty virupas (shashtiamsas of strength) make one rupa. Keep full precision until an authorized diagnostic display.

vedic_sign_entries.degree_limits: Pairs give the degree boundaries in Phaladeepika I.7. Preserve exact exaltation peaks at shared boundaries; use vedic/dignity/sign-dignities.yaml for single-label endpoint precedence.
vedic_sign_entries.dignity: Peak degrees are measured within this sign. Empty collections mean no assignment among the seven classical grahas. Moolatrikona sign membership alone cannot establish a degree-specific dignity.
vedic_sign_entries.glossary: Movable, fixed and dual describe modes of expression. Krura and saumya are traditional forceful and gentle sign classes. Gender and body correspondences are symbolic.

vedic_varga_entries.equal_parts: With zero-based natal sign and part indices, take floor(degrees within sign × parts / 30). Add stride × part to the seed modulo 12. The D2 rows give the result directly.
vedic_varga_entries.input: Use the same unrounded sidereal longitude for the selected point or Lagna in every division. Normalize modulo 360 degrees.
vedic_varga_entries.reading: Count houses from the divisional Lagna. Recompute it throughout the stated birth-time uncertainty. Use each method's existing read_access setting.
vedic_varga_entries.seed_order: Aries is odd. Parity runs odd/even, modality movable/fixed/dual, element fire/earth/air/water.
vedic_varga_entries.unequal_parts: D30 selects the parity row using lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive band edges in degrees.
vedic_varga_entries.weights: Absolute Vimshopaka points within each 20-point scheme. Zero marks a chart outside the ten-chart scheme. These are weights for planetary dignity aggregation.

western_outer_planet_entries.orbs: Resolve the named natal table and compare absolute angular deviation inclusively. Only listed major aspects qualify for personal use.

meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में तलवार · इक्का की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಿ · ಒಂದು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/ace-of-wands-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on a spark of interest. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank ace in the wands family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में छड़ी · इक्का की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಲು · ಒಂದು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/adhi-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Under this candidate profile Mercury, Venus and Jupiter each occupy one of the sixth, seventh or eighth signs from Moon.

meaning.en: A grouping of planets read in relation to the Moon.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा के सापेक्ष देखा जाने वाला ग्रहों का समूह।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಓದುವ ಗ್ರಹಗಳ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ.

glossary/entries/adhika-masa.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.adhika-masa: Within the selected new-moon interval classify the month using calendar-profiles.yaml. Match exactly zero solar ingresses. Label using the sign of the next ingress; keep a two-ingress month separately flagged.

meaning.en: An extra lunar month used to keep lunar months aligned with the solar year.
meaning.hi: चंद्र महीनों को सौर वर्ष के साथ रखने के लिए जोड़ा गया महीना।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಮಾಸಗಳನ್ನು ಸೌರವರ್ಷದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಲು ಸೇರಿಸುವ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ತಿಂಗಳು.

glossary/entries/adi-nadi.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.nadi: Look up each Moon’s birth star in the three Nadi groups, then read the class-pair matrix. Keep the raw points when a selected exception softens interpretation.

meaning.en: Birth-star group 1 of three used for one part of marriage matching.
meaning.hi: विवाह मिलान में जन्म तारों की तीन श्रेणियों में क्रम 1।
meaning.kn: ವಿವಾಹ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುವ ಮೂರು ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 1ನೇ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/aditi.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. Read the linked star entries for the source and any competing assignment. The entrance grid places it at N7.

meaning.en: Aditi is a traditional figure associated with Punarvasu.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पथ के इस हिस्से से जुड़ा पारंपरिक नाम: पुनर्वसु।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು: ಪುನರ್ವಸು.

glossary/entries/agni-vastu-guardian.yam.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.vishakha: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: The traditional guardian associated with the southeast part of a building plan.
meaning.hi: घर के नक्शे के दक्षिणपूर्व भाग से जुड़े पारंपरिक रक्षक।
meaning.kn: ಮನೆಯ ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಆಗ್ನೇಯ ಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಪಾಲಕ.

glossary/entries/ahi.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. The entrance grid places it at N2.

meaning.en: The traditional name for entrance position N2 in the building plan.
meaning.hi: भवन के नक्शे में प्रवेश की जगह N2 का पारंपरिक नाम।
meaning.kn: ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ N2 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/ahir-budhnya.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. Read the linked star entries for the source and any competing assignment. Select the star using its measured span.

meaning.en: Ahir Budhnya is a traditional figure associated with Uttara Bhadrapada.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पथ के इस हिस्से से जुड़ा पारंपरिक नाम: उत्तरभाद्रपदा।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು: ಉತ್ತರಭಾದ್ರಪದಾ.

glossary/entries/air-hand-shape.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Square palm, longer fingers.
meaning.hi: चौकोर हथेली, लंबी उँगलियाँ।
meaning.kn: ಚೌಕಾಕಾರದ ಅಂಗೈ, ಉದ್ದ ಬೆರಳುಗಳು.

glossary/entries/aja-ekapada.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. Read the linked star entries for the source and any competing assignment. Select the star using its measured span.

meaning.en: Aja Ekapada is a traditional figure associated with Purva Bhadrapada.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पथ के इस हिस्से से जुड़ा पारंपरिक नाम: पूर्वभाद्रपदा।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು: ಪೂರ್ವಭಾದ್ರಪದಾ.

glossary/entries/amala-yoga.yaml.admin_note: At least one graha classified as benefic under the selected profile occupies the tenth sign from the named reference.

meaning.en: A traditional pattern linking a supportive planet with work and responsibilities.
meaning.hi: सहायक ग्रह को काम और ज़िम्मेदारियों से जोड़ने वाला पारंपरिक मेल।
meaning.kn: ಪೂರಕ ಗ್ರಹವನ್ನು ಕೆಲಸ ಮತ್ತು ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ.

glossary/entries/amanta.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a calendar convention in which the lunar month ends at the new Moon. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A calendar convention in which the lunar month ends at the new Moon.
meaning.hi: अमावस्या पर चंद्र मास समाप्त करने की रीति।
meaning.kn: ಅಮಾವಾಸ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಂದ್ರಮಾಸ ಮುಗಿಯುವ ಪದ್ಧತಿ.

glossary/entries/amatyakaraka.yaml.admin_note: Select the bound graha only if it holds AmK: rank 2 of seven or rank 2 of eight under chara-karakas/methods.yaml. Require a unique rank across the chart uncertainty interval.

meaning.en: The planet assigned to represent work and advice by its place in a ranked list.
meaning.hi: स्थिति के क्रम से सलाह और काम का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला ग्रह।
meaning.kn: ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ರಮದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಸಲಹೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲಸ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಆಯ್ದ ಗ್ರಹ.

glossary/entries/amavasya.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.amavasya: Identify the instantaneous tithi by its one-based number in [30]. For the ordinary calendar day label query that number at local sunrise. Retain every actual matching sunrise and the exact interval even when it falls between sunrises.

meaning.en: The new-Moon day at the end of the dark half of the month.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पक्ष का 15वाँ दिन (अमावस्या)।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಕ್ಷದ 15ನೇ ದಿನ (ಅಮಾವಾಸ್ಯೆ).

glossary/entries/amrit-choghadiya.yaml.admin_note: This label is slot 4 in the stored day cycle. Look up the weekday-specific start and use the separate night cycle after sunset.

meaning.en: One of seven labels rotated through the eight daytime or nighttime intervals of a weekday.
meaning.hi: दिन या रात के आठ हिस्सों में क्रम से दिए जाने वाले सात नामों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಹಗಲು ಅಥವಾ ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಎಂಟು ಅವಧಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/anapha-yoga.yaml.admin_note: At least one of Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn occupies the twelfth sign(s) counted from the natal Moon; for both sides require a separate occupant on each.

meaning.en: One of five eligible planets occupies the sign before the Moon.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा से पिछली राशि में पाँच पात्र ग्रहों में से कोई एक होना।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ರಾಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಐದು ಗ್ರಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಇರುವುದು.

glossary/entries/antariksha.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. The entrance grid places it at E8.

meaning.en: The traditional name for entrance position E8 in the building plan.
meaning.hi: भवन के नक्शे में प्रवेश की जगह E8 का पारंपरिक नाम।
meaning.kn: ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ E8 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/antya-nadi.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.nadi: Look up each Moon’s birth star in the three Nadi groups, then read the class-pair matrix. Keep the raw points when a selected exception softens interpretation.

meaning.en: Birth-star group 3 of three used for one part of marriage matching.
meaning.hi: विवाह मिलान में जन्म तारों की तीन श्रेणियों में क्रम 3।
meaning.kn: ವಿವಾಹ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುವ ಮೂರು ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 3ನೇ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/anuradha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.anuradha: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 17 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 17।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 17ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/apas.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. Read the linked star entries for the source and any competing assignment. Select the star using its measured span.

meaning.en: Apas is a traditional figure associated with Purva Ashadha.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पथ के इस हिस्से से जुड़ा पारंपरिक नाम: पूर्वाषाढा।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು: ಪೂರ್ವಾಷಾಢಾ.

glossary/entries/apollo-mount.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Raised pad beneath the ring finger.
meaning.hi: अनामिका के नीचे उभरा भाग।
meaning.kn: ಉಂಗುರದ ಬೆರಳಿನ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುವ ಭಾಗ.

term.kn: ಉಂಗುರದ ಬೆರಳಿನ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುವ ಭಾಗ

glossary/entries/aquarius.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.signs.aquarius: The selected tropical point falls in [300, 330) degrees from the March equinox. Fixed air; modern ruler uranus, traditional ruler saturn.

meaning.en: Sign number 11 in the twelve-part circle, covering degrees 300 to 330.
meaning.hi: बारह राशियों में क्रम 11, 300 से 330 अंश तक।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರದ 11ನೇ ಭಾಗ, 300ರಿಂದ 330 ಅಂಶಗಳವರೆಗೆ.

glossary/entries/arcminute.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for one sixtieth of a degree of angle. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: One sixtieth of a degree of angle.
meaning.hi: कोण के एक अंश का साठवाँ भाग।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಅಂಶದ ಅರವತ್ತನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/arcsecond.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for one sixtieth of an arcminute, or one 3,600th of a degree. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: One sixtieth of an arcminute, or one 3,600th of a degree.
meaning.hi: कोण के एक मिनट का साठवाँ भाग।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಕೋನ ನಿಮಿಷದ ಅರವತ್ತನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/ardra.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.ardra: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 6 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 6।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 6ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/argala.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for planets in certain places counted from a sign can add an influence to its reading. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Planets in certain places counted from a sign can add an influence to its reading.
meaning.hi: राशि से गिने गए कुछ स्थानों के ग्रहों का अतिरिक्त प्रभाव।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಯಿಂದ ಎಣಿಸಿದ ಕೆಲವು ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ಗ್ರಹಗಳು ಓದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಭಾವ.

glossary/entries/aries.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.signs.aries: The selected tropical point falls in [0, 30) degrees from the March equinox. Cardinal fire; modern ruler mars, traditional ruler mars.

meaning.en: Sign number 1 in the twelve-part circle, covering degrees 0 to 30.
meaning.hi: बारह राशियों में क्रम 1, 0 से 30 अंश तक।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರದ 1ನೇ ಭಾಗ, 0ರಿಂದ 30 ಅಂಶಗಳವರೆಗೆ.

glossary/entries/arudha-lagna.yaml.admin_note: Application in jaimini.arudha-padas.arudha-lagna: Bind the requested D1 house 1 and compute A1 with arudha-padas/methods.yaml. Read its visible expression only if its final sign is stable.

meaning.en: A point calculated from the rising sign and its ruler to explore a person’s public image.
meaning.hi: उदय राशि और उसके स्वामी से निकला बिंदु जिससे सार्वजनिक छवि पर विचार किया जाता है।
meaning.kn: ಉದಯ ರಾಶಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಅಧಿಪತಿಯಿಂದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಚಿತ್ರಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಸ್ಥಾನ.

glossary/entries/arudha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.prashna.arudha: Bind the sign explicitly recorded from the questioner’s placement of the token in the Kerala sign diagram. Keep this observed sign, its ruler, and the actual Prashna lagna separately. Missing observation gives no Arudha.

meaning.en: A calculated place in a chart used to explore how a part of life may appear to others.
meaning.hi: जीवन का कोई पहलू दूसरों को कैसा दिख सकता है, इसे देखने के लिए निकाला गया स्थान।
meaning.kn: ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ಅಂಶ ಇತರರಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ನೋಡಲು ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವ ಸ್ಥಾನ.

glossary/entries/aryaman.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. Read the linked star entries for the source and any competing assignment. Select the star using its measured span.

meaning.en: Aryaman is a traditional figure associated with Uttara Phalguni.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पथ के इस हिस्से से जुड़ा पारंपरिक नाम: उत्तरफल्गुनी।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು: ಉತ್ತರಫಲ್ಗುನೀ.

glossary/entries/ashlesha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.ashlesha: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 9 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 9।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 9ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/ashtakavarga.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a method that counts contributions from eight starting points across the signs. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A method that counts contributions from eight starting points across the signs.
meaning.hi: आठ शुरुआती स्थानों से मिली गिनतियों को राशियों के अनुसार रखने की विधि।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಂಟು ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/ashtakoota.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.nadi: Look up each Moon’s birth star in the three Nadi groups, then read the class-pair matrix. Keep the raw points when a selected exception softens interpretation.

meaning.en: A marriage-matching method that compares two birth charts using eight factors.
meaning.hi: दो जन्मपत्रियों को आठ पहलुओं पर मिलाने की विधि।
meaning.kn: ಇಬ್ಬರ ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎಂಟು ಅಂಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಲಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/ashtama-shani.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.doshas.ashtama-shani: Within a solved transit interval, Saturn occupies the eighth sign counted inclusively from the natal Moon. Split intervals at each exit and return.

meaning.en: Saturn’s passage through the eighth sign counted from the Moon’s birth sign.
meaning.hi: जन्म की चंद्र राशि से आठवीं राशि में शनि का चलना।

Never simulate a ritual input or send this evidence to the public projection.

glossary/entries/bhadrika-yogini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-yogini.balance-calculation: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

meaning.en: A period lasting 5 years in the repeating 36-year sequence.
meaning.hi: ३६ वर्ष के चक्र में 5 वर्ष की अवधि।

glossary/entries/bhramari-yogini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-yogini.balance-calculation: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

meaning.en: A period lasting 4 years in the repeating 36-year sequence.

glossary/entries/birth-balance.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-vimshottari.balance-calculation: Normalize the sidereal Moon longitude to [0°,360°). Each of the 27 stars spans 48000 arcseconds. Divide longitude by this width: the integer quotient selects the star from Ashwini and the remainder is the arc traversed. With f = remainder / 48000 and Y = years of the star lord, elapsed years = Y × f and remaining years = Y × (1 − f). Maha starts at birth minus elapsed time and ends at birth plus remaining time. At an exact edge, select the next star with its full balance.

glossary/entries/cheshta-bala.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.cheshta: Use solar Ayana for the Sun and lunar Paksha for the Moon. For Mars, Jupiter and Saturn use the mean Sun as the fast point and the planet mean as the slow point. For Mercury and Venus swap these roles. Move halfway from the slow point to the true planet along the shortest signed arc in [−180,180). Divide the shorter arc from that midpoint to the fast point by three. Mean and true longitudes must share frame and epoch.

meaning.en: The part of a planet’s strength connected with its apparent movement.

meaning.hi: दिन और रात को अलग-अलग आठ नाम वाले हिस्सों में बाँटने की सारणी।
meaning.kn: ಹಗಲು ಮತ್ತು ರಾತ್ರಿಯನ್ನು ತಲಾ ಎಂಟು ಹೆಸರಿನ ಭಾಗಗಳಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ.

glossary/entries/combustion.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.states.combustion: For an eligible graha, match when its shortest natal longitude separation from the Sun is at or below its motion-specific threshold. Exclude the Sun and both nodes.

meaning.en: A planet lies close enough to the Sun in the sky to meet a traditional distance threshold.
meaning.hi: सूर्य से तय दूरी के अंदर किसी ग्रह का आना।

glossary/entries/composite.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a relationship chart made by taking the midpoints between corresponding positions in two charts. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A relationship chart made by taking the midpoints between corresponding positions in two charts.

meaning.kn: ಎರಡು ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುಗಳಿಂದ ಮಾಡುವ ನಕ್ಷೆ.

glossary/entries/compound-number.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the total before repeated addition reduces it to a single digit. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The total before repeated addition reduces it to a single digit.

glossary/entries/conjunction.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.aspects.conjunction: For a bound natal pair, accept shortest circular separation within 8 degrees of 0 degrees, inclusive.

meaning.en: Two bodies occupy the same sign or appear near the same point, according to the method used.
meaning.hi: पद्धति के अनुसार दो ग्रहों का एक राशि में या पास दिखाई देना।
meaning.kn: ವಿಧಾನದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಎರಡು ಗ್ರಹಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ರಾಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಕಾಣುವುದು.

glossary/entries/cross-palm-mark.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Two intersecting strokes.
meaning.hi: एक दूसरे को काटती दो रेखाएँ।

meaning.hi: चुनी हुई विधि में घर को दर्शाने वाला गणित से निकला बिंदु।

meaning.en: The birth chart used to explore life context.

meaning.hi: दीपों का त्योहार जिसकी तिथि क्षेत्र और स्थानीय पंचांग के अनुसार बदल सकती है।
meaning.kn: ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಪಂಚಾಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ದಿನ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದಾದ ದೀಪಗಳ ಹಬ್ಬ.

glossary/entries/degree.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for one of the 360 equal parts of a full turn. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: One of the 360 equal parts of a full turn.
meaning.hi: पूरे चक्र के ३६० बराबर भागों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ೩೬೦ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/descendant.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the point on the zodiac setting in the west at the time of the chart. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The point on the zodiac setting in the west at the time of the chart.
meaning.hi: उस समय पश्चिम में डूब रहा राशि चक्र का बिंदु।
meaning.kn: ಆ ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೆ ಪಶ್ಚಿಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸ್ತವಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರದ ಬಿಂದು.

glossary/entries/deva-gana.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.gana: Read both natal star classes and look up their ordered temperamental grouping. Labels belong to the table only.

meaning.en: One of the three traditional groups of birth stars, bearing the label Deva.
meaning.hi: जन्म तारों के तीन पारंपरिक समूहों में देव नाम का समूह।
meaning.kn: ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ಮೂರು ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದೇವ ಎಂಬ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/dhana-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.yogas.dhana: Second or eleventh lord is linked to fifth or ninth lord by conjunction or exchange.

meaning.en: A traditional grouping of chart positions used when discussing resources.
meaning.hi: संसाधनों पर विचार करते समय देखा जाने वाला मेल।
meaning.kn: ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಚರ್ಚಿಸುವಾಗ ನೋಡುವ ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಜೋಡಣೆ.

glossary/entries/dhanishta.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.dhanishta: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 23 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 23।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 23ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/dhanya-yogini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-yogini.balance-calculation: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

meaning.en: A period lasting 3 years in the repeating 36-year sequence.
meaning.hi: ३६ वर्ष के चक्र में 3 वर्ष की अवधि।
meaning.kn: ೩೬ ವರ್ಷದ ಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ 3 ವರ್ಷ ಇರುವ ಅವಧಿ.

glossary/entries/dhriti-calendar-yoga.ya.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.yoga: Use 1 + floor(((sidereal Moon + sidereal Sun) modulo a turn) / 48000 arcseconds). Select the ordered yoga and solve the bracketing sum-angle crossings.

meaning.en: Interval 8 of 27 found by adding the positions of the Sun and Moon.
meaning.hi: सूर्य और चंद्रमा की जगह जोड़ने से मिलने वाले २७ हिस्सों में क्रम 8।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ೨೭ ಅವಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 8ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/dhruva-calendar-yoga.ya.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.yoga: Use 1 + floor(((sidereal Moon + sidereal Sun) modulo a turn) / 48000 arcseconds). Select the ordered yoga and solve the bracketing sum-angle crossings.

meaning.en: Interval 12 of 27 found by adding the positions of the Sun and Moon.
meaning.hi: सूर्य और चंद्रमा की जगह जोड़ने से मिलने वाले २७ हिस्सों में क्रम 12।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ೨೭ ಅವಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 12ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/dig-bala.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the part of a planet’s traditional strength calculated from its direction in the chart. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The part of a planet’s traditional strength calculated from its direction in the chart.
meaning.hi: पत्री में ग्रह की दिशा से निकला बल।
meaning.kn: ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ರಹ ಇರುವ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಿಂದ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವ ಬಲ.

glossary/entries/dignity.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a description of how a planet’s position relates to the signs it rules or is traditionally associated with. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A description of how a planet’s position relates to the signs it rules or is traditionally associated with.
meaning.hi: ग्रह और उसकी वर्तमान राशि के बीच का पारंपरिक संबंध।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹ ಇರುವ ರಾಶಿಗೂ ಆ ಗ್ರಹಕ್ಕೂ ಪರಂಪರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸಂಬಂಧ.

glossary/entries/dispositor.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the planet that rules the sign occupied by another planet. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The planet that rules the sign occupied by another planet.
meaning.hi: उस राशि का स्वामी जिसमें कोई दूसरा ग्रह बैठा है।
meaning.kn: ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಗ್ರಹ ಇರುವ ರಾಶಿಯ ಅಧಿಪತಿ.

glossary/entries/diti.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. The entrance grid places it at N8.

meaning.en: The traditional name for entrance position N8 in the building plan.
meaning.hi: भवन के नक्शे में प्रवेश की जगह N8 का पारंपरिक नाम।
meaning.kn: ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ N8 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/dominant-hand.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the hand a person reports using more often for skilled tasks. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The hand a person reports using more often for skilled tasks.
meaning.hi: बारीक काम के लिए व्यक्ति जिस हाथ का अधिक उपयोग बताता है।
meaning.kn: ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ತಾನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಳಸುವುದಾಗಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೇ ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ಕೈ.

glossary/entries/dosha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a traditional label for a combination that readers examine more closely. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A traditional label for a combination that readers examine more closely.
meaning.hi: किसी विशेष मेल का पारंपरिक नाम जिसे पढ़ते समय अधिक ध्यान से देखा जाता है।
meaning.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಗಮನದಿಂದ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುವ ಜೋಡಣೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/double-transit.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.transits.double-transit: Bind a selected natal whole-sign house from Lagna. At one instant both Jupiter and Saturn must each occupy its sign or cast a full graha aspect to it, using vedic/aspects/full-graha.yaml. Intersect their windows.

meaning.en: A timing check in which Jupiter and Saturn both connect with the same chart topic.
meaning.hi: समय की ऐसी जाँच जिसमें गुरु और शनि दोनों एक ही विषय से जुड़ते हैं।
meaning.kn: ಗುರು ಮತ್ತು ಶನಿ ಎರಡೂ ಒಂದೇ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುವ ಕಾಲದ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ.

glossary/entries/drik-bala.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.drik: For each other classical graha compute (target longitude − caster longitude) modulo 360. Interpolate the common aspect between consecutive knots. At the start and end of each special-aspect interval use the selected caster’s special peak at the indicated knot, interpolating between adjacent knot values. Add benefic aspects and subtract malefic aspects, then divide by four. Jupiter and Venus are benefic. Moon is benefic for elongation in (0,180]; Mercury is benefic unless sharing a natal sign with Sun, Mars, Saturn or a dark Moon.

meaning.en: The part of a planet’s strength drawn from the angles other planets make to it.
meaning.hi: दूसरे ग्रहों के साथ कोणों से निकला बल।
meaning.kn: ಇತರ ಗ್ರಹಗಳೊಡನೆ ಇರುವ ಕೋನಗಳಿಂದ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವ ಬಲ.

glossary/entries/durudhara-yoga.yaml.admin_note: At least one of Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn occupies the second and twelfth sign(s) counted from the natal Moon; for both sides require a separate occupant on each.

meaning.en: Eligible planets occupy the signs on both sides of the Moon.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा के दोनों ओर की राशियों में पात्र ग्रह होना।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಯ ರಾಶಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅರ್ಹ ಗ್ರಹಗಳಿರುವುದು.

glossary/entries/dusthana.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the sixth, eighth or twelfth part of a birth chart, grouped together for interpretation. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A traditional grouping of chart areas linked with service, change and reflection.
meaning.hi: सेवा, बदलाव और चिंतन से जुड़े क्षेत्रों का एक पारंपरिक समूह।
meaning.kn: ಸೇವೆ, ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/dvadashi.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.tithi: At the query instant compute E = (Moon − Sun) modulo 1296000 arcseconds. The public number is 1 + floor(E / 43200); use the zero-based quotient for indexing only. Resolve name and paksha in limb-tables.yaml and bracket the two true crossings as specified in limbs.yaml.

meaning.en: Lunar day 12 of a fortnight, measured by the changing distance of the Moon from the Sun.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पक्ष का 12वाँ दिन।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಕ್ಷದ 12ನೇ ದಿನ.

glossary/entries/dvitiya.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.tithi: At the query instant compute E = (Moon − Sun) modulo 1296000 arcseconds. The public number is 1 + floor(E / 43200); use the zero-based quotient for indexing only. Resolve name and paksha in limb-tables.yaml and bracket the two true crossings as specified in limbs.yaml.

meaning.en: Lunar day 2 of a fortnight, measured by the changing distance of the Moon from the Sun.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पक्ष का 2वाँ दिन।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಕ್ಷದ 2ನೇ ದಿನ.

glossary/entries/earth-hand-shape.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Square palm, shorter fingers.
meaning.hi: चौकोर हथेली, छोटी उँगलियाँ।
meaning.kn: ಚೌಕಾಕಾರದ ಅಂಗೈ, ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಬೆರಳುಗಳು.

glossary/entries/ecliptic.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the path the Sun appears to follow around the sky over a year. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The path the Sun appears to follow around the sky over a year.
meaning.hi: साल भर में आकाश पर सूर्य की दिखाई देने वाली राह।
meaning.kn: ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂರ್ಯನು ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಗಿದಂತೆ ಕಾಣುವ ಮಾರ್ಗ.

glossary/entries/eight-of-cups-tarot.yam.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on leaving something behind. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank eight in the cups family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में प्याला · आठ की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆ · ಎಂಟು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/eight-of-pentacles-taro.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on practising a skill. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank eight in the pentacles family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में मुद्रा · आठ की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಣ್ಯ · ಎಂಟು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/eight-of-swords-tarot.y.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on perceived limits. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank eight in the swords family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में तलवार · आठ की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಿ · ಎಂಟು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/eight-of-wands-tarot.ya.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on swift communication. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank eight in the wands family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में छड़ी · आठ की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಲು · ಎಂಟು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/ekadashi.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.ekadashi: Identify the instantaneous tithi by its one-based number in [11, 26]. For the ordinary calendar day label query that number at local sunrise. Retain every actual matching sunrise and the exact interval even when it falls between sunrises.

meaning.en: Lunar day 11 of a fortnight, measured by the changing distance of the Moon from the Sun.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पक्ष का 11वाँ दिन।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಕ್ಷದ 11ನೇ ದಿನ.

glossary/entries/ekadhipatya.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a reduction comparing the two signs ruled by the same planet. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A reduction comparing the two signs ruled by the same planet.
meaning.hi: एक ग्रह की दो राशियों की तुलना से गिनती घटाना।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಗ್ರಹ ಆಳುವ ಎರಡು ರಾಶಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ಮೊತ್ತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು.

glossary/entries/electional-astrology.ya.admin_note: Use this label for using calendar and sky conditions to compare possible starting times for an activity. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Using calendar and sky conditions to compare possible starting times for an activity.
meaning.hi: किसी काम के संभावित आरंभ समयों की तुलना के लिए पंचांग और आकाश की स्थितियाँ देखना।
meaning.kn: ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಆರಂಭದ ಸಮಯಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು ಪಂಚಾಂಗ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕಾಶದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುವುದು.

glossary/entries/element.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a symbolic category such as earth, water, fire or air used to group features in a reading. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A symbolic category such as earth, water, fire or air used to group features in a reading.
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी, जल, अग्नि या वायु जैसी प्रतीकात्मक श्रेणी।
meaning.kn: ಪೃಥ್ವಿ, ಜಲ, ಅಗ್ನಿ ಅಥವಾ ವಾಯುವಿನಂತಹ ಸಾಂಕೇತಿಕ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/entrance-pada.yaml.admin_note: Application in vastu.entrances.north: Observed main entrance faces north in the recorded compass convention.

meaning.en: One division of a building’s outside edge used to describe the location of an entrance.
meaning.hi: प्रवेश की जगह बताने के लिए भवन की बाहरी सीमा का एक भाग।
meaning.kn: ಪ್ರವೇಶದ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಗುರುತಿಸಲು ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ಹೊರ ಅಂಚಿನ ಒಂದು ವಿಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/ephemeris.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a table or calculation giving the positions of celestial bodies for particular times. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A table or calculation giving the positions of celestial bodies for particular times.
meaning.hi: तय समय पर आकाशीय पिंडों की जगह देने वाली तालिका या गणना।
meaning.kn: ನಿಗದಿತ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಆಕಾಶಕಾಯಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾನ ತೋರಿಸುವ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ ಅಥವಾ ಲೆಕ್ಕ.

glossary/entries/equal-house.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a chart layout with twelve houses of thirty degrees each, beginning at the rising point. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A chart layout with twelve houses of thirty degrees each, beginning at the rising point.
meaning.hi: उदय बिंदु से शुरू तीस-तीस अंश के बारह घरों की पत्री।
meaning.kn: ಉದಯ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ ತಲಾ ಮೂವತ್ತು ಅಂಶಗಳ ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ಮನೆಗಳ ನಕ್ಷೆ.

glossary/entries/exaltation.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.uchcha: Take the shorter longitude arc in degrees from the exact KB-02 debilitation point and divide by three. The opposite point gives sixty virupas.

meaning.en: The sign or precise position in which a planet is traditionally considered especially well placed.
meaning.hi: वह राशि या बिंदु जहाँ ग्रह को विशेष बल वाला माना जाता है।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಗ್ರಹಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಬೆಂಬಲವಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುವ ರಾಶಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬಿಂದು.

glossary/entries/expression-number.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a number found by adding the values of all letters in a name. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A number found by adding the values of all letters in a name.
meaning.hi: नाम के सभी अक्षरों के मान जोड़कर निकली संख्या।
meaning.kn: ಹೆಸರಿನ ಎಲ್ಲ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

glossary/entries/face-reading.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a tradition that uses voluntarily identified facial features as prompts for reflection. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A tradition that uses voluntarily identified facial features as prompts for reflection.
meaning.hi: अपनी इच्छा से पहचानी चेहरे की विशेषताओं पर विचार करने की परंपरा।
meaning.kn: ಸ್ವಯಂ ಗುರುತಿಸಿದ ಮುಖಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಪರಂಪರೆ.

glossary/entries/fate-line.yaml.admin_note: Application in palmistry.lines.fate-right: The user confirmed the illustrated choice on the right hand: Upright crease toward the middle finger.

meaning.en: A palm crease running up towards the middle finger.
meaning.hi: हथेली पर मध्यमा की ओर जाती रेखा।
meaning.kn: ಅಂಗೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಬೆರಳಿನತ್ತ ಸಾಗುವ ಗೆರೆ.

glossary/entries/fire-hand-shape.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Long palm, shorter fingers.
meaning.hi: लंबी हथेली, छोटी उँगलियाँ।
meaning.kn: ಉದ್ದ ಅಂಗೈ, ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಬೆರಳುಗಳು.

glossary/entries/five-card-career-spread.admin_note: Read the positions in order: current-task, skill-to-use, work-constraint, available-support, next-step. The final prompt invites reflection or a chosen action.

meaning.en: Five cards explore a task, a skill, a constraint, available support and a next step.
meaning.hi: पाँच पत्तों से काम, कौशल, सीमा, सहारा और अगला कदम देख सकते हैं।
meaning.kn: ಐದು ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಕೆಲಸ, ಕೌಶಲ, ಮಿತಿ, ಸಹಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದಿನ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಬಹುದು.

glossary/entries/five-card-relationship-.admin_note: Read the positions in order: own-perspective, other-perspective-to-explore, shared-question, personal-boundary, next-step. The final prompt invites reflection or a chosen action.

meaning.en: Five cards explore two perspectives, a shared question, a personal boundary and a next step.
meaning.hi: दो नज़रिए, साझा सवाल, निजी सीमा और अगले कदम के लिए पाँच पत्ते।
meaning.kn: ಎರಡು ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನ, ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ, ಮಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದಿನ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಾಗಿ ಐದು ಪತ್ರಗಳು.

glossary/entries/five-of-cups-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on disappointment. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank five in the cups family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में प्याला · पाँच की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆ · ಐದು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/five-of-pentacles-tarot.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on seeking practical help. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank five in the pentacles family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में मुद्रा · पाँच की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಣ್ಯ · ಐದು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/five-of-swords-tarot.ya.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on the cost of conflict. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank five in the swords family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में तलवार · पाँच की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಿ · ಐದು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/five-of-wands-tarot.yam.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on creative disagreement. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank five in the wands family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में छड़ी · पाँच की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಲು · ಐದು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/fixed-sign.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.signs.taurus: Match the selected D1 graha or ascendant when its stable sidereal sign is Vrishabha.

meaning.en: A sign in the group associated with maintaining a steady course.
meaning.hi: स्थिरता बनाए रखने से जुड़े समूह की राशि।
meaning.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಗುಂಪಿನ ರಾಶಿ.

glossary/entries/four-of-cups-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on quiet contemplation. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank four in the cups family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में प्याला · चार की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆ · ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/four-of-pentacles-tarot.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on protecting resources. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank four in the pentacles family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में मुद्रा · चार की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಣ್ಯ · ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/four-of-swords-tarot.ya.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on a restful pause. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank four in the swords family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में तलवार · चार की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಿ · ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/four-of-wands-tarot.yam.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on celebrating together. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank four in the wands family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में छड़ी · चार की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಲು · ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/gaja-kesari-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Moon-based screen: Jupiter occupies an angle from the Moon.

meaning.en: A pattern based on the relative positions of Jupiter and the Moon.
meaning.hi: बृहस्पति और चंद्रमा की आपसी स्थिति पर आधारित मेल।
meaning.kn: ಗುರು ಮತ್ತು ಚಂದ್ರನ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ.

glossary/entries/gana.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.gana: Read both natal star classes and look up their ordered temperamental grouping. Labels belong to the table only.

meaning.en: One of three traditional birth-star groups compared in matching.
meaning.hi: मिलान में देखे जाने वाले जन्म तारों के तीन समूहों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಲಿಸುವ ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ಮೂರು ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/ganda-calendar-yoga.yam.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.yoga: Use 1 + floor(((sidereal Moon + sidereal Sun) modulo a turn) / 48000 arcseconds). Select the ordered yoga and solve the bracketing sum-angle crossings.

meaning.en: Interval 10 of 27 found by adding the positions of the Sun and Moon.
meaning.hi: सूर्य और चंद्रमा की जगह जोड़ने से मिलने वाले २७ हिस्सों में क्रम 10।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ೨೭ ಅವಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 10ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/gandharva.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. The entrance grid places it at S6.

meaning.en: The traditional name for entrance position S6 in the building plan.
meaning.hi: भवन के नक्शे में प्रवेश की जगह S6 का पारंपरिक नाम।
meaning.kn: ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ S6 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/gara.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.karana: Use floor(((Moon − Sun) modulo a turn) / 21600 arcseconds). Use the fixed index map at 0 and 57–59; for 1–56 use movable[(index−1) modulo 7]. Solve the flanking 6° crossings.

meaning.en: A half lunar day named in a repeating seven-part sequence.
meaning.hi: सात नामों के दोहराते क्रम का एक आधा चंद्र दिन।
meaning.kn: ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಕ್ರಮದ ಒಂದು ಅರ್ಧ ತಿಥಿ.

glossary/entries/gemini.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.signs.gemini: The selected tropical point falls in [60, 90) degrees from the March equinox. Mutable air; modern ruler mercury, traditional ruler mercury.

meaning.en: Sign number 3 in the twelve-part circle, covering degrees 60 to 90.
meaning.hi: बारह राशियों में क्रम 3, 60 से 90 अंश तक।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರದ 3ನೇ ಭಾಗ, 60ರಿಂದ 90 ಅಂಶಗಳವರೆಗೆ.

glossary/entries/geocentric.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for measured as seen from the centre of Earth. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Measured as seen from the centre of Earth.
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी के केंद्र से देखकर मापा हुआ।
meaning.kn: ಭೂಮಿಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರದಿಂದ ಕಂಡಂತೆ ಅಳೆಯುವುದು.

glossary/entries/gnatikaraka.yaml.admin_note: Select the bound graha only if it holds GK: rank 6 of seven or rank 7 of eight under chara-karakas/methods.yaml. Require a unique rank across the chart uncertainty interval.

meaning.en: The planet assigned to represent kin and challenges by its place in a ranked list.
meaning.hi: स्थिति के क्रम से कुटुंब और चुनौतियाँ का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला ग्रह।
meaning.kn: ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ರಮದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಬಂಧುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸವಾಲುಗಳು ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಆಯ್ದ ಗ್ರಹ.

glossary/entries/gochara.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for where a planet is moving now compared with a chosen chart. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Where a planet is moving now compared with a chosen chart.
meaning.hi: चुनी हुई पत्री की तुलना में अभी ग्रह की चलती हुई स्थिति।
meaning.kn: ಆಯ್ದ ನಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದಾಗ ಈಗ ಗ್ರಹ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸ್ಥಾನ.

glossary/entries/golden-dawn.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a historical society whose system links tarot cards to stars, planets and elements. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A historical society whose system links tarot cards to stars, planets and elements.
meaning.hi: टैरो पत्तों को तारों, ग्रहों और तत्त्वों से जोड़ने वाली ऐतिहासिक संस्था।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳಿಗೆ ತಾರೆ, ಗ್ರಹ ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿದ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಸಂಘ.

glossary/entries/graha-drishti.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.states.graha-drishti: Count forward from the source graha’s D1 sign as one. Match a full aspect when the target sign falls at a listed distance for that source.

meaning.en: A planet is read in relation to places counted from its position.
meaning.hi: ग्रह से गिने गए कुछ स्थानों के साथ उसका संबंध।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹದಿಂದ ಎಣಿಸಿದ ಕೆಲವು ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳೊಡನೆ ಅದರ ಸಂಬಂಧ.

glossary/entries/graha-maitri.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.graha-maitri: Use the two classical Moon-sign rulers and read the natural-relationship matrix in declared order.

meaning.en: A matching factor comparing the rulers of two Moon signs and their traditional relationships.
meaning.hi: दो चंद्र राशियों के स्वामियों के पारंपरिक संबंध की तुलना।
meaning.kn: ಎರಡು ಚಂದ್ರರಾಶಿಗಳ ಅಧಿಪತಿಗಳ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಸಂಬಂಧದ ಹೋಲಿಕೆ.

glossary/entries/graha-yuddha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.states.graha-yuddha: Match two distinct eligible planets less than one degree apart in natal longitude. Among a matched pair, the planet farther north by signed ecliptic latitude wins under this profile.

meaning.en: Two eligible planets appear close enough together for a traditional comparison of their positions.
meaning.hi: बहुत पास दिखने वाले दो पात्र ग्रहों की स्थिति की पारंपरिक तुलना।
meaning.kn: ತುಂಬ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಕಾಣುವ ಎರಡು ಗ್ರಹಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೋಲಿಕೆ.

glossary/entries/graha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a planet, light or crossing point used to read an Indian birth chart. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A planet, light or crossing point used to read an Indian birth chart.
meaning.hi: भारतीय जन्मपत्री में देखा जाने वाला ग्रह, सूर्य, चंद्रमा या दो पथों का मिलन बिंदु।
meaning.kn: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುವ ಗ್ರಹ, ಸೂರ್ಯ, ಚಂದ್ರ ಅಥವಾ ಪಥಗಳ ಛೇದನ ಬಿಂದು.

glossary/entries/grahan.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.doshas.grahan: The natal Sun or Moon shares a sidereal sign with Rahu or Ketu. Bind each matching pair separately.

meaning.en: A label for the Sun or Moon near a lunar crossing point, with closer checks needed for an actual eclipse.
meaning.hi: सूर्य या चंद्रमा के चंद्र पथ के कटान के पास होने का नाम।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಥದ ಛೇದನದ ಬಳಿ ಸೂರ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಚಂದ್ರ ಇರುವ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಹೆಸರು.

public_label.en: Sun or Moon near a lunar node
public_label.hi: चंद्र पथ के कटान के पास सूर्य या चंद्रमा
public_label.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಥದ ಸಂಧಿಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಬಳಿ ಸೂರ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಚಂದ್ರ

glossary/entries/grand-trine.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.patterns.grand-trine: Three distinct natal planets make all three trines within the natal trine orb. Element agreement is descriptive; the edge test admits out-of-sign contacts.

meaning.en: Three positions about a third of a circle apart from one another.
meaning.hi: तीन स्थान जो एक दूसरे से लगभग एक तिहाई चक्र दूर हैं।
meaning.kn: ಪರಸ್ಪರ ವೃತ್ತದ ಮೂರನೇ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗದಷ್ಟು ದೂರವಿರುವ ಮೂರು ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳು.

glossary/entries/grid-palm-mark.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Crossing sets of short parallel strokes.
meaning.hi: एक दूसरे को काटते छोटी समानांतर रेखाओं के समूह।
meaning.kn: ಅಡ್ಡಹಾಯುವ ಸಮಾಂತರ ಸಣ್ಣ ಗೆರೆಗಳ ಗುಂಪು.

term.hi: एक दूसरे को काटते छोटी समानांतर रेखाओं के समूह

glossary/entries/griha-pravesha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.muhurta.griha-pravesha: For the selected activity compare a city-specific, boundary-stable interval using this profile and the shared ranking policy. Require the listed participants. Bind all factors and each exception to this same interval.

meaning.en: A traditional occasion marking entry into a new home.
meaning.hi: नए घर में प्रवेश का पारंपरिक अवसर।
meaning.kn: ಹೊಸ ಮನೆಗೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಆಚರಿಸುವ ಸಂದರ್ಭ.

glossary/entries/gulika-kalam.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.gulika-kalam: For the local sunrise weekday select j from limbs.yaml day_eighths_sunday_first.gulika. Let D = (sunset − sunrise)/8. Match from sunrise + (j−1)D inclusive until sunrise + jD exclusive.

meaning.en: One of eight daylight sections identified by a weekday rule.
