meaning.en: The largest planet in our solar system.
meaning.hi: सौरमंडल का सबसे बड़ा ग्रह।
meaning.kn: ಸೌರವ್ಯೂಹದ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಗ್ರಹ.

glossary/entries/justice-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on a fair decision. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: A named picture card, numbered 11, used as a prompt for reflection.
meaning.hi: चिंतन के लिए चित्र वाला पत्ता, जिसका क्रमांक 11 है।
meaning.kn: ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ 11 ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಚಿತ್ರಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/jyeshtha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.jyeshtha: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 18 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 18।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 18ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/jyotish.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for an Indian tradition of calendar calculation and interpretation of the sky. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An Indian tradition of calendar calculation and interpretation of the sky.
meaning.hi: समय की गणना और आकाश की स्थिति पढ़ने की भारतीय परंपरा।
meaning.kn: ಕಾಲಗಣನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕಾಶದ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ಅರ್ಥೈಸುವಿಕೆಯ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಪರಂಪರೆ.

glossary/entries/kaal-choghadiya.yaml.admin_note: This label is slot 5 in the stored day cycle. Look up the weekday-specific start and use the separate night cycle after sunset.

meaning.en: One of seven labels rotated through the eight daytime or nighttime intervals of a weekday.
meaning.hi: दिन या रात के आठ हिस्सों में क्रम से दिए जाने वाले सात नामों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಹಗಲು ಅಥವಾ ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಎಂಟು ಅವಧಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/kaal-sarp.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a disputed label for a chart where planets lie on one side of the Moon’s two crossing points. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A disputed label for a chart where planets lie on one side of the Moon’s two crossing points.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पथ के दो कटान बिंदुओं की एक ओर ग्रह होने का विवादित नाम।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಥದ ಎರಡು ಛೇದನಗಳ ಒಂದೇ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ರಹಗಳಿರುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೆಲವರು ಬಳಸುವ ವಿವಾದಿತ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/kakshya.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-ashtakavarga.kakshya: Normalize the current sidereal transit longitude modulo a full circle. Within its sign use the zero-based floor of arcminutes divided by 225. Look up the lord at that index, then read only that contributor’s bit in the transiting graha’s raw prastara for the transit sign. Re-evaluate on boundary crossings in either direction.

meaning.en: One of eight equal parts of a sign used to read a moving planet against a contribution table.
meaning.hi: चलते ग्रह को पढ़ने के लिए राशि के आठ बराबर भागों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹದ ಚಲನೆ ಓದಲು ಒಂದು ರಾಶಿಯ ಎಂಟು ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/kala-bala.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the part of a planet’s strength calculated from time-related conditions. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The part of a planet’s strength calculated from time-related conditions.
meaning.hi: समय की स्थितियों से निकला ग्रह बल का भाग।
meaning.kn: ಸಮಯದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳಿಂದ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವ ಗ್ರಹಬಲದ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/kalachakra.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a timing system whose order of signs depends on the Moon’s position at birth. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A timing system whose order of signs depends on the Moon’s position at birth.
meaning.hi: जन्म के चंद्रमा की जगह से राशियों का समयक्रम तय करने की विधि।
meaning.kn: ಜನನದ ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನದಿಂದ ರಾಶಿಗಳ ಕಾಲಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/kalapurusha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a symbolic figure used to associate the twelve signs with parts of the body. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A symbolic figure used to associate the twelve signs with parts of the body.
meaning.hi: बारह राशियों को शरीर के अंगों से जोड़ने वाला प्रतीकात्मक रूप।
meaning.kn: ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ರಾಶಿಗಳಿಗೆ ದೇಹದ ಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಂಕೇತಿಕವಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ಆಕೃತಿ.

glossary/entries/kantaka-shani.yaml.admin_note: MODERN/POPULAR regional Kantaka counts the angular signs from the natal Moon. The fourth-only rule is Ardhashtama.

meaning.en: A traditional label for Saturn’s passage through specified places counted from the Moon.
meaning.hi: जन्म के चंद्रमा से कुछ तय स्थानों में शनि के चलने का पारंपरिक नाम।
meaning.kn: ಜನ್ಮದ ಚಂದ್ರನಿಂದ ಕೆಲವು ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶನಿ ಸಾಗುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/karaka.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a planet chosen to represent a subject such as learning or partnership. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A planet chosen to represent a subject such as learning or partnership.
meaning.hi: सीखने या साझेदारी जैसे विषय का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला ग्रह।
meaning.kn: ಕಲಿಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಒಡನಾಟದಂತಹ ವಿಷಯದ ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಯಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುವ ಗ್ರಹ.

glossary/entries/karakamsa.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the sign of the leading personal indicator in the nine-part chart, used as a starting point. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The sign of the leading personal indicator in the nine-part chart, used as a starting point.
meaning.hi: नौ भागों वाली पत्री में मुख्य व्यक्तिगत संकेतक की राशि।
meaning.kn: ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಭಾಗಗಳ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಖ್ಯ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸೂಚಕ ಇರುವ ರಾಶಿ.

glossary/entries/karakatva.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a subject traditionally represented by a planet. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A subject traditionally represented by a planet.
meaning.hi: ग्रह से पारंपरिक रूप से जोड़ा गया विषय।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಗ್ರಹ ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುವ ವಿಷಯ.

glossary/entries/karana.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.karana: Use floor(((Moon − Sun) modulo a turn) / 21600 arcseconds). Use the fixed index map at 0 and 57–59; for 1–56 use movable[(index−1) modulo 7]. Solve the flanking 6° crossings.

meaning.en: Half of one of the thirty parts of the Moon’s monthly cycle.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा के मासिक चक्र के तीस हिस्सों में से एक का आधा।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಮಾಸಿಕ ಚಕ್ರದ ಮೂವತ್ತು ಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದರ ಅರ್ಧ.

glossary/entries/kartika.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.deepavali: Match the local date selected by the Deepavali evening rule in calendar-profiles.yaml. Bind the ritual, regional month name, tithi interval and candidate evenings.

meaning.en: A lunar month associated with several regional festival observances.
meaning.hi: कई क्षेत्रीय त्योहारों से जुड़ा चंद्र मास।
meaning.kn: ಹಲವು ಪ್ರಾದೇಶಿಕ ಹಬ್ಬಗಳು ನಡೆಯುವ ಚಂದ್ರಮಾಸ.

glossary/entries/kashta-phala.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a calculated measure of strain in a particular strength method. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A calculated measure of strain in a particular strength method.
meaning.hi: बल की एक विधि में दबाव का गणितीय माप।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಬಲಗಣನೆಯ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಒತ್ತಡವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಅಳತೆ.

glossary/entries/kaulava.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.karana: Use floor(((Moon − Sun) modulo a turn) / 21600 arcseconds). Use the fixed index map at 0 and 57–59; for 1–56 use movable[(index−1) modulo 7]. Solve the flanking 6° crossings.

meaning.en: A half lunar day named in a repeating seven-part sequence.
meaning.hi: सात नामों के दोहराते क्रम का एक आधा चंद्र दिन।
meaning.kn: ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಕ್ರಮದ ಒಂದು ಅರ್ಧ ತಿಥಿ.

glossary/entries/kemadruma-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Neither adjacent sign to the Moon contains Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn. Apply the cancellations before displaying the reading.

meaning.en: Neither sign beside the Moon contains one of the five planets used in this check.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की दोनों पड़ोसी राशियों में जाँच के पाँच ग्रहों में से कोई न होना।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಎರಡು ರಾಶಿಗಳಲ್ಲೂ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಐದು ಗ್ರಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಜೋಡಣೆ.

glossary/entries/kendra.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the first, fourth, seventh or tenth place counted from a starting position. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Chart areas associated with self, home, partnerships and work.
meaning.hi: पहचान, घर, साझेदारी और काम से जुड़े क्षेत्र।
meaning.kn: ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವ, ಮನೆ, ಪಾಲುದಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳು.

glossary/entries/kendradi.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.kendradi: Count whole signs inclusively from natal Lagna. Group houses in repeating angular, succedent and cadent order and award the corresponding value.

meaning.en: A strength contribution based on distance from the four corners of the chart.
meaning.hi: पत्री के चार कोनों से दूरी पर आधारित बल।
meaning.kn: ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಮೂಲೆಗಳಿಂದ ದೂರದ ಆಧಾರದ ಬಲ.

glossary/entries/ketu.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.planets.ketu: Match Ketu when the selected D1 chart point is its computed natal placement.

meaning.en: The point where the Moon crosses the Sun’s apparent path heading south.
meaning.hi: वह बिंदु जहाँ चंद्रमा सूर्य के मार्ग को दक्षिण की ओर काटता है।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನು ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಪಥವನ್ನು ದಕ್ಷಿಣಕ್ಕೆ ದಾಟುವ ಬಿಂದು.

glossary/entries/khala-parivartana.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for two rulers exchange places involving the third house and excluding houses six, eight and twelve. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An exchange between chart rulers involving communication and personal effort.
meaning.hi: संवाद और अपने प्रयासों के क्षेत्र से जुड़ा स्वामियों का स्थान परिवर्तन।
meaning.kn: ಸಂವಹನ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಪ್ರಯತ್ನದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಅಧಿಪತಿಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾನ ವಿನಿಮಯ.

glossary/entries/kimstughna.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.karana: Use floor(((Moon − Sun) modulo a turn) / 21600 arcseconds). Use the fixed index map at 0 and 57–59; for 1–56 use movable[(index−1) modulo 7]. Solve the flanking 6° crossings.

meaning.en: A half lunar day with a fixed place in the month.
meaning.hi: चंद्र मास में तय जगह वाला आधा चंद्र दिन।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಮಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಗದಿತ ಸ್ಥಾನವಿರುವ ಅರ್ಧ ತಿಥಿ.

glossary/entries/king-of-cups-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on steady compassion. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank king in the cups family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में प्याला · राजा की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆ · ರಾಜ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/king-of-pentacles-tarot.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on responsible stewardship. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank king in the pentacles family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में मुद्रा · राजा की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಣ್ಯ · ರಾಜ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/king-of-swords-tarot.ya.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on reasoned judgement. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank king in the swords family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में तलवार · राजा की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಿ · ರಾಜ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/king-of-wands-tarot.yam.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on a motivating vision. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank king in the wands family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में छड़ी · राजा की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಲು · ರಾಜ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/knight-of-cups-tarot.ya.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on a heartfelt gesture. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank knight in the cups family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में प्याला · सवार की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆ · ಸವಾರ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/knight-of-pentacles-tar.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on steady routine. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank knight in the pentacles family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में मुद्रा · सवार की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಣ್ಯ · ಸವಾರ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/knight-of-swords-tarot..admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on direct action. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank knight in the swords family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में तलवार · सवार की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಿ · ಸವಾರ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/knight-of-wands-tarot.y.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on enthusiasm. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank knight in the wands family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में छड़ी · सवार की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಲು · ಸವಾರ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/koch.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a time-based way of dividing a chart into twelve houses. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A time-based way of dividing a chart into twelve houses.
meaning.hi: समय के आधार पर पत्री को बारह घरों में बाँटने की विधि।
meaning.kn: ಸಮಯದ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ಮನೆಗಳಾಗಿ ಭಾಗಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/koota.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for one factor in a traditional comparison of two birth charts for marriage. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: One factor in a traditional comparison of two birth charts for marriage.
meaning.hi: विवाह के लिए दो जन्मपत्रियों की तुलना में देखा जाने वाला एक पहलू।
meaning.kn: ವಿವಾಹಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಎರಡು ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸುವಾಗ ನೋಡುವ ಒಂದು ಅಂಶ.

glossary/entries/kp-sublord.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the planet assigned to the small part of a star section that contains the point being read. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The planet assigned to the small part of a star section that contains the point being read.
meaning.hi: देखा जा रहा बिंदु नक्षत्र के जिस छोटे हिस्से में आता है, उससे जुड़ा ग्रह।
meaning.kn: ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುವ ಬಿಂದು ಇರುವ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರದ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಗದಿಯಾದ ಗ್ರಹ.

glossary/entries/kp.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for an Indian method that associates each chart point with the rulers of successively smaller parts of the sky. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An Indian method that associates each chart point with the rulers of successively smaller parts of the sky.
meaning.hi: आकाश के छोटे हिस्सों से जुड़े स्वामियों को देखने की भारतीय विधि।
meaning.kn: ಆಕಾಶದ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳಿಗೆ ನೀಡಿದ ಅಧಿಪತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುವ ಭಾರತೀಯ ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/krishna-paksha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the half of the lunar month from full Moon to new Moon. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The half of the lunar month from full Moon to new Moon.
meaning.hi: पूर्णिमा से अमावस्या तक महीने का आधा हिस्सा।
meaning.kn: ಹುಣ್ಣಿಮೆಯಿಂದ ಅಮಾವಾಸ್ಯೆಯವರೆಗಿನ ತಿಂಗಳ ಅರ್ಧ.

glossary/entries/krittika.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.krittika: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 3 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 3।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 3ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/krura.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a traditional category for a sign or planet described as forceful. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A traditional category for a sign or planet described as forceful.
meaning.hi: राशि या ग्रह में तीव्रता बताने वाली पारंपरिक श्रेणी।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿ ಅಥವಾ ಗ್ರಹಕ್ಕೆ ತೀವ್ರತೆ ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ವರ್ಗ.

glossary/entries/kshaya.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a calendar label for a missing interval, such as an omitted lunar month. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A calendar label for a missing interval, such as an omitted lunar month.
meaning.hi: पंचांग में महीना या समय खंड छूट जाने का नाम।
meaning.kn: ಪಂಚಾಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ತಿಂಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ಕಾಲಭಾಗ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಹೋಗುವುದರ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/kua.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a number used in a Chinese system for grouping directions. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A number used in a Chinese system for grouping directions.
meaning.hi: चीनी पद्धति में दिशाओं के समूह देखने की संख्या।
meaning.kn: ಚೀನಿ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಗುಂಪುಮಾಡಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

glossary/entries/kubera-vastu-guardian.y.admin_note: Application in vastu.directions.north: The north is associated with Kubera and mercury.

meaning.en: The traditional guardian associated with the north part of a building plan.
meaning.hi: घर के नक्शे के उत्तर भाग से जुड़े पारंपरिक रक्षक।
meaning.kn: ಮನೆಯ ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಉತ್ತರ ಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಪಾಲಕ.

glossary/entries/kumara-age-state.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.states.baladi: Divide the graha’s natal sign into five successive six-degree intervals. Read the odd-sign order from Aries onward by sign parity and reverse the order in even signs. Normalize 30 degrees to the next sign before lookup.

meaning.en: A symbolic stage described as developing when a planet falls in the corresponding part of a sign.
meaning.hi: राशि में जगह से तय प्रतीकात्मक अवस्था: विकास।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಂಕೇತಿಕ ಹಂತ: ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ.

glossary/entries/kusumadanta.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. The entrance grid places it at W4.

meaning.en: The traditional name for entrance position W4 in the building plan.
meaning.hi: भवन के नक्शे में प्रवेश की जगह W4 का पारंपरिक नाम।
meaning.kn: ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ W4 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/labh-choghadiya.yaml.admin_note: This label is slot 3 in the stored day cycle. Look up the weekday-specific start and use the separate night cycle after sunset.

meaning.en: One of seven labels rotated through the eight daytime or nighttime intervals of a weekday.
meaning.hi: दिन या रात के आठ हिस्सों में क्रम से दिए जाने वाले सात नामों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಹಗಲು ಅಥವಾ ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಎಂಟು ಅವಧಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/lagna.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.natal.ascendant: Present the tropical ascendant sign only with a reliable birth time.

meaning.en: The sign or exact point rising in the east at a particular time and place.
meaning.hi: किसी स्थान और समय पर पूर्व में उगता हुआ चिह्न या सटीक बिंदु।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೆ ಪೂರ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಉದಯಿಸುವ ರಾಶಿ ಅಥವಾ ನಿಖರ ಬಿಂದು.

glossary/entries/lahiri.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a widely used choice for measuring the offset between the seasonal and star-based zodiacs. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A widely used choice for measuring the offset between the seasonal and star-based zodiacs.
meaning.hi: ऋतुओं और तारों पर आधारित राशि चक्रों का अंतर मापने की एक विधि।
meaning.kn: ಋತು ಮತ್ತು ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ ಆಧಾರಿತ ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುವ ಒಂದು ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/lakshmi-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Both Venus and the ninth lord occupy an own or exaltation sign in an angle or trine from Lagna. When Venus rules the ninth, evaluate its single placement.

meaning.en: A pattern connecting Venus with the chart area of teachers and guiding values.
meaning.hi: शुक्र को शिक्षकों और मार्गदर्शक मूल्यों के क्षेत्र से जोड़ने वाला मेल।
meaning.kn: ಶುಕ್ರನನ್ನು ಗುರುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ.

glossary/entries/lal-kitab.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a South Asian reading tradition with its own house-based rules and suggested practices. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A South Asian reading tradition with its own house-based rules and suggested practices.
meaning.hi: घरों की पढ़ाई और वैकल्पिक अभ्यासों की दक्षिण एशियाई पद्धति।
meaning.kn: ಮನೆಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಓದು ಮತ್ತು ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಏಷ್ಯಾದ ಪದ್ಧತಿ.

glossary/entries/latitude.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for an angle north or south of the reference circle used for a position. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An angle north or south of the reference circle used for a position.
meaning.hi: जगह बताने वाले आधार वृत्त से उत्तर या दक्षिण का कोण।
meaning.kn: ಆಧಾರ ವೃತ್ತದಿಂದ ಉತ್ತರ ಅಥವಾ ದಕ್ಷಿಣದ ಕೋನ.

glossary/entries/leo.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.signs.leo: The selected tropical point falls in [120, 150) degrees from the March equinox. Fixed fire; modern ruler sun, traditional ruler sun.

meaning.en: Sign number 5 in the twelve-part circle, covering degrees 120 to 150.
meaning.hi: बारह राशियों में क्रम 5, 120 से 150 अंश तक।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರದ 5ನೇ ಭಾಗ, 120ರಿಂದ 150 ಅಂಶಗಳವರೆಗೆ.

glossary/entries/libra.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.signs.libra: The selected tropical point falls in [180, 210) degrees from the March equinox. Cardinal air; modern ruler venus, traditional ruler venus.

meaning.en: Sign number 7 in the twelve-part circle, covering degrees 180 to 210.
meaning.hi: बारह राशियों में क्रम 7, 180 से 210 अंश तक।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರದ 7ನೇ ಭಾಗ, 180ರಿಂದ 210 ಅಂಶಗಳವರೆಗೆ.

glossary/entries/life-broken-line.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Thumb-side arc with a visible gap.
meaning.hi: अँगूठे की ओर मुड़ती रेखा में दिखाई देता अंतर।
meaning.kn: ಹೆಬ್ಬೆರಳಿನ ಬದಿಯ ಬಾಗಿದ ಗೆರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತರ.

term.hi: अँगूठे की ओर मुड़ती रेखा में दिखाई देता अंतर

glossary/entries/life-line.yaml.admin_note: Application in palmistry.lines.life-right: The user confirmed the illustrated choice on the right hand: Arc around the base of the thumb.

meaning.en: The crease around the base of the thumb, used here to reflect on daily pace and energy.
meaning.hi: अँगूठे की जड़ को घेरती रेखा जिससे यहाँ दिनचर्या और ऊर्जा पर विचार किया जाता है।
meaning.kn: ಹೆಬ್ಬೆರಳಿನ ಬುಡದ ಸುತ್ತಲಿನ ಗೆರೆ; ಇಲ್ಲಿ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನಕ್ರಮದ ಕುರಿತು ಯೋಚಿಸಲು ಬಳಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

glossary/entries/life-path.yaml.admin_note: Application in numerology.pythagorean.life-path: Reduce the Gregorian birth month, day and year separately, add the three results and reduce again.

meaning.en: A number found by combining the day, month and year of birth.
meaning.hi: जन्म का दिन, महीना और वर्ष जोड़कर निकाली जाने वाली संख्या।
meaning.kn: ಜನನದ ದಿನ, ತಿಂಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

glossary/entries/life-short-line.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Thumb-side arc ending partway around the pad.
meaning.hi: अँगूठे के उभार के चारों ओर कुछ दूर जाकर समाप्त होती रेखा।
meaning.kn: ಹೆಬ್ಬೆರಳಿನ ಬುಡದ ಸುತ್ತ ಅರ್ಧದಲ್ಲೇ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಗೆರೆ.

term.hi: अँगूठे के उभार के चारों ओर कुछ दूर जाकर समाप्त होती रेखा
term.kn: ಹೆಬ್ಬೆರಳಿನ ಬುಡದ ಸುತ್ತ ಅರ್ಧದಲ್ಲೇ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಗೆರೆ

glossary/entries/lo-shu.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a three-by-three number grid used here to arrange digits from the birth date. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A three-by-three number grid used here to arrange digits from the birth date.
meaning.hi: जन्मतिथि के अंक रखने का नौ खानों वाला वर्ग।
meaning.kn: ಜನ್ಮದಿನಾಂಕದ ಅಂಕಿಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಕೋಣೆಗಳ ಚೌಕ.

glossary/entries/long-finger-proportion..admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Fingers look long relative to the palm.
meaning.hi: हथेली की तुलना में लंबी उँगलियाँ।
meaning.kn: ಅಂಗೈಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದರೆ ಉದ್ದದ ಬೆರಳುಗಳು.

term.hi: हथेली की तुलना में लंबी उँगलियाँ

glossary/entries/longitude.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for an angle measured along a reference circle, used to locate a place on Earth or in the sky. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An angle measured along a reference circle, used to locate a place on Earth or in the sky.
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी या आकाश में जगह बताने के लिए आधार वृत्त के साथ मापा गया कोण।
meaning.kn: ಭೂಮಿ ಅಥವಾ ಆಕಾಶದ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಗುರುತಿಸಲು ಆಧಾರ ವೃತ್ತದ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೂ ಅಳೆಯುವ ಕೋನ.

glossary/entries/luminary.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for either the Sun or Moon when they are considered together as the two lights of a chart. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Either the Sun or Moon when they are considered together as the two lights of a chart.
meaning.hi: पत्री के दो प्रकाशक पिंडों में से सूर्य या चंद्रमा।
meaning.kn: ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಎರಡು ಬೆಳಕುಗಳಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿದಾಗ ಸೂರ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಚಂದ್ರ.

glossary/entries/luna-mount.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Raised outer pad near the wrist.
meaning.hi: कलाई के पास बाहरी किनारे पर उभार।
meaning.kn: ಮಣಿಕಟ್ಟಿನ ಬಳಿ ಹೊರ ಅಂಚಿನ ಉಬ್ಬು.

term.hi: कलाई के पास बाहरी किनारे पर उभार

glossary/entries/lunar-node.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for one of the two places where the Moon’s path crosses the Sun’s apparent path. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: One of the two places where the Moon’s path crosses the Sun’s apparent path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा के पथ और सूर्य के दिखाई देने वाले मार्ग के दो कटान बिंदुओं में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಪಥ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಪಥವನ್ನು ದಾಟುವ ಎರಡು ಬಿಂದುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/madhya-nadi.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.nadi: Look up each Moon’s birth star in the three Nadi groups, then read the class-pair matrix. Keep the raw points when a selected exception softens interpretation.

meaning.en: Birth-star group 2 of three used for one part of marriage matching.
meaning.hi: विवाह मिलान में जन्म तारों की तीन श्रेणियों में क्रम 2।
meaning.kn: ವಿವಾಹ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುವ ಮೂರು ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 2ನೇ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/magha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.magha: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 10 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 10।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 10ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/magnetic-declination.ya.admin_note: Use this label for the angle between compass north and geographic north at a place and date. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The angle between compass north and geographic north at a place and date.
meaning.hi: किसी जगह और तारीख पर चुंबकीय उत्तर और भौगोलिक उत्तर के बीच का कोण।
meaning.kn: ಸ್ಥಳ ಮತ್ತು ದಿನಾಂಕಕ್ಕೆ ದಿಕ್ಸೂಚಿಯ ಉತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕ ಉತ್ತರದ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ.

glossary/entries/maha-dasha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the main period in a sequence of longer and shorter periods. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The main period in a sequence of longer and shorter periods.
meaning.hi: समय के क्रम में सबसे बड़ी अवधि।
meaning.kn: ಸಮಯವನ್ನು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಮದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅವಧಿ.

glossary/entries/maha-parivartana.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.yogas.parivartana-maha: Two distinct classical lords occupy each other’s houses and neither house is 3, 6, 8 or 12.

meaning.en: A traditional category of exchange between chart rulers.
meaning.hi: कुंडली में स्वामियों के स्थान परिवर्तन की एक पारंपरिक श्रेणी।
meaning.kn: ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಅಧಿಪತಿಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾನ ವಿನಿಮಯದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ವರ್ಗ.

glossary/entries/mahendra.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a matching factor based on counting from one person’s birth star to the other. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A matching factor based on counting from one person’s birth star to the other.
meaning.hi: एक के जन्म तारे से दूसरे के जन्म तारे तक गिनने का पहलू।
meaning.kn: ಒಬ್ಬರ ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷತ್ರದಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರದವರೆಗೆ ಎಣಿಸುವ ಅಂಶ.

glossary/entries/major-arcana.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the twenty-two named picture cards in the tarot deck. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The twenty-two named picture cards in the tarot deck.

glossary/entries/mangala-yogini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-yogini.balance-calculation: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

meaning.en: A period lasting 1 years in the repeating 36-year sequence.

meaning.en: A sign in the group associated with adjusting or changing direction.
meaning.hi: ढलने या दिशा बदलने से जुड़े समूह की राशि।
meaning.kn: ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಗುಂಪಿನ ರಾಶಿ.

glossary/entries/nadi.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.nadi: Look up each Moon’s birth star in the three Nadi groups, then read the class-pair matrix. Keep the raw points when a selected exception softens interpretation.

meaning.en: In matching, one of three groups assigned to each person’s birth star.
meaning.hi: मिलान में जन्म तारों को दिए तीन समूहों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳಿಗೆ ನೀಡುವ ಮೂರು ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/naga.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.karana: Use floor(((Moon − Sun) modulo a turn) / 21600 arcseconds). Use the fixed index map at 0 and 57–59; for 1–56 use movable[(index−1) modulo 7]. Solve the flanking 6° crossings.

meaning.en: A half lunar day with a fixed place in the month.
meaning.hi: चंद्र मास में तय जगह वाला आधा चंद्र दिन।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಮಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಗದಿತ ಸ್ಥಾನವಿರುವ ಅರ್ಧ ತಿಥಿ.

glossary/entries/naisargika-bala.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.naisargika: Multiply the ordinal rank by sixty and divide by seven. Saturn begins at rank one and Sun ends at rank seven. Keep the fraction through summation.

meaning.en: A fixed traditional weight assigned according to which planet is being considered.
meaning.hi: ग्रह की पहचान के अनुसार दिया जाने वाला निश्चित बल।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹದ ಗುರುತಿನ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಬಲ.

glossary/entries/nakshatra-nadi.yaml.admin_note: This name is reserved by the product plan. It has no active calculation or reading. The Nadi factor in the marriage-matching module has its own glossary entry.

meaning.en: A birth-star classification used in some traditions, with the specific method chosen before comparison.
meaning.hi: तुलना से पहले विधि चुनकर इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला जन्म तारों का वर्गीकरण।
meaning.kn: ಹೋಲಿಕೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ವಿಧಾನ ಆಯ್ದು ಬಳಸುವ ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ.

glossary/entries/nakshatra-syllable.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.padas.check-personal-baby-name-pada: Chosen spelling has a reviewed initial sound matching the stable birth pada in the selected regional table.

meaning.en: A traditional starting sound for a name chosen from the Moon’s section at birth.
meaning.hi: जन्म में चंद्रमा की जगह से नाम के लिए सुझाई जाने वाली शुरुआती ध्वनि।
meaning.kn: ಜನನದ ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನದಿಂದ ಹೆಸರಿಗೆ ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಆರಂಭದ ಧ್ವನಿ.

glossary/entries/nakshatra.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.nakshatra: Use 1 + floor((sidereal Moon modulo a turn) / 48000 arcseconds). Resolve that numbered KB-03 catalog row and its rule ID. Solve start and end on the Moon’s unwrapped longitude.

meaning.en: One of the sky’s 27 equal sections used to track the Moon.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की स्थिति बताने के लिए आकाश के २७ बराबर हिस्सों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಆಕಾಶದ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/narayana-dasha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a system that assigns years to signs and chooses the starting sign by comparing their strength. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A system that assigns years to signs and chooses the starting sign by comparing their strength.
meaning.hi: राशियों का बल देखकर शुरुआत चुनने और वर्ष बाँटने की विधि।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಗಳ ಬಲವನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ಆರಂಭದ ರಾಶಿಯನ್ನು ಆಯ್ದು ವರ್ಷಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/nathonnata.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.nathonnata: Let t be local apparent solar hours since solar midnight modulo twenty-four. Day strength is five times min(t,24−t). Nocturnal grahas take sixty minus that value. Mercury receives sixty.

meaning.en: A strength contribution based on the time’s distance from midday or midnight.
meaning.hi: दोपहर या आधी रात से समय की दूरी पर आधारित बल।
meaning.kn: ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ ಅಥವಾ ಮಧ್ಯರಾತ್ರಿಯಿಂದ ಸಮಯದ ಅಂತರದ ಆಧಾರದ ಬಲ.

glossary/entries/navagraha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the nine celestial indicators used in traditional Indian charts. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The nine celestial indicators used in traditional Indian charts.
meaning.hi: भारतीय जन्मपत्री में देखे जाने वाले नौ आकाशीय संकेतक।
meaning.kn: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುವ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಆಕಾಶ ಸೂಚಕಗಳು.

glossary/entries/navami.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.tithi: At the query instant compute E = (Moon − Sun) modulo 1296000 arcseconds. The public number is 1 + floor(E / 43200); use the zero-based quotient for indexing only. Resolve name and paksha in limb-tables.yaml and bracket the two true crossings as specified in limbs.yaml.

meaning.en: Lunar day 9 of a fortnight, measured by the changing distance of the Moon from the Sun.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पक्ष का 9वाँ दिन।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಕ್ಷದ 9ನೇ ದಿನ.

glossary/entries/neecha-bhanga-raja-yoga.admin_note: Application in vedic.yogas.neecha-bhanga-raja: For the same debilitated classical graha, match any listed relief branch: The dispositor occupies a kendra from Lagna or Moon. The ruler of the selected graha’s exaltation sign occupies a kendra from Lagna or Moon. The distinct rulers of the debilitation and exaltation signs occupy mutual kendras. The dispositor casts a full graha aspect on the selected debilitated graha. Under the alternate reading of tunganatha, a classical planet exalted in the occupied sign is angular from Lagna or Moon. The selected graha is debilitated in D1 but occupies its exaltation sign in D9. The ruler of the selected graha’s D9 sign occupies a D1 angle or trine and either Lagna is movable or the Lagna lord occupies a movable navamsha. Also require the recovered graha in a D1 kendra from Lagna.

meaning.en: A planet may be less at ease in its sign. Other chart factors can shape how its connection to responsibility is read.
meaning.hi: किसी राशि में ग्रह कम सहज माना जा सकता है। ज़िम्मेदारी से उसके संबंध को समझने में कुंडली के दूसरे संकेत भी मदद कर सकते हैं।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ರಾಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಜತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರಬಹುದು. ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅದರ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಓದುವಾಗ ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಇತರ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನೂ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬಹುದು.

glossary/entries/neecha-bhanga.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.yogas.neecha-bhanga: For the same debilitated classical graha, match any listed relief branch: The dispositor occupies a kendra from Lagna or Moon. The ruler of the selected graha’s exaltation sign occupies a kendra from Lagna or Moon. The distinct rulers of the debilitation and exaltation signs occupy mutual kendras. The dispositor casts a full graha aspect on the selected debilitated graha. Under the alternate reading of tunganatha, a classical planet exalted in the occupied sign is angular from Lagna or Moon. The selected graha is debilitated in D1 but occupies its exaltation sign in D9. The ruler of the selected graha’s D9 sign occupies a D1 angle or trine and either Lagna is movable or the Lagna lord occupies a movable navamsha.

meaning.en: A second chart condition can moderate the traditional reading of a planet in its least supported sign.
meaning.hi: दूसरा मेल जो कम बल वाली स्थिति की व्याख्या बदल सकता है।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಂಬಲದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯ ಓದನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಜೋಡಣೆ.

glossary/entries/neptune.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.planets.neptune: Use the cohort meaning when the selected natal placement is Neptune. Add the personal reading only with a chart-specific contact.

meaning.en: The planet numbered 8 outward from the Sun.
meaning.hi: सूर्य से 8वाँ ग्रह।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯನಿಂದ 8ನೇ ಗ್ರಹ.

glossary/entries/nirriti-vastu-guardian..admin_note: Application in vastu.directions.southwest: The southwest is associated with Nirriti and rahu.

meaning.kn: ಮನೆಯ ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ನೈಋತ್ಯ ಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಪಾಲಕ.

glossary/entries/non-dominant-hand.yaml.admin_note: Application in palmistry.mounts.jupiter-right: The user confirmed the illustrated choice on the right hand: Raised pad beneath the index finger.

meaning.hi: जब व्यक्ति एक हाथ अधिक इस्तेमाल करता है तब उसका दूसरा हाथ।

glossary/entries/ojayugma.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.ojayugma: Independently award fifteen for qualifying sign parity in D1 and D9. Moon and Venus use even signs and the other grahas use odd signs. Aries is sign one.

meaning.en: A strength contribution based on odd and even signs in two charts.
meaning.hi: दो पत्रियों में सम और विषम राशियों से निकला बल।
meaning.kn: ಎರಡು ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಸ ರಾಶಿಗಳಿಂದ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಬಲ.

glossary/entries/opposition.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.aspects.opposition: For a bound natal pair, accept shortest circular separation within 8 degrees of 180 degrees, inclusive.

meaning.hi: आकाश के चक्र में लगभग 180 अंश दूर दो स्थान।
meaning.kn: ಆಕಾಶವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 180 ಅಂಶ ದೂರವಿರುವ ಎರಡು ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳು.

glossary/entries/pada.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for one of the four equal parts of a Moon section, or a marked section of an entrance in home planning. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.hi: चंद्रमा के एक आकाश खंड का चौथाई भाग या घर के प्रवेश का चिह्नित हिस्सा।

glossary/entries/paksha-bala.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.paksha: Let L be the shorter Sun–Moon arc divided by three. Award L to Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus, and sixty minus L to Sun, Mars and Saturn. Use the undoubled Moon amount here and in Cheshta.

meaning.en: The part of time-based strength derived from the changing separation of Sun and Moon.
meaning.hi: सूर्य और चंद्रमा की बदलती दूरी से निकला समय बल।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಚಂದ್ರರ ನಡುವಿನ ಅಂತರದಿಂದ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಕಾಲಬಲದ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/paksha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.paksha: Let L be the shorter Sun–Moon arc divided by three. Award L to Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus, and sixty minus L to Sun, Mars and Saturn. Use the undoubled Moon amount here and in Cheshta.

meaning.en: The half of the lunar month when the Moon is growing brighter or growing dimmer.
meaning.hi: महीने का वह आधा भाग जिसमें चंद्रमा की रोशनी बढ़ती या घटती है।

glossary/entries/pingala-yogini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-yogini.balance-calculation: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

glossary/entries/progression.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-narayana.progression: At birth begin with the stronger of Lagna and its seventh, using the strength comparison in periods.yaml. Use the ninth from that seed to select direction as in Chara. Traverse the seed-modality offsets in that direction. Saturn in the seed gives ordinary forward succession; otherwise Ketu in the seed reverses the normal direction. Compute first-cycle lengths by directed lord distance and dignity as in Chara. Cap a first-pass length at twelve for this complementary profile. In the second pass the same sign receives twelve minus its first length. Skip zero spans. For Antar take the stronger of the parent sign and its seventh. Start in the sign occupied by its lord. Count forward from an odd start, backward from an even start. Saturn in the stronger sign forces forward; otherwise Ketu there reverses direction. Each child takes one twelfth.

meaning.en: A timing method that lets one day after birth stand for one year of life in this library.
meaning.hi: यहाँ समय देखने की विधि जिसमें जन्म के बाद का एक दिन जीवन के एक वर्ष के बराबर लिया जाता है।
meaning.kn: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಜನನದ ನಂತರದ ಒಂದು ದಿನವನ್ನು ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷವಾಗಿ ನೋಡುವ ಕಾಲಗಣನೆ.

glossary/entries/puja.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for an act of worship a person may choose as part of their tradition. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An act of worship a person may choose as part of their tradition.
meaning.hi: व्यक्ति की पसंद के अनुसार किया जाने वाला पूजन।
meaning.kn: ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ತನ್ನ ಪರಂಪರೆಗೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಆಯಬಹುದಾದ ಆರಾಧನೆ.

glossary/entries/punarvasu.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.punarvasu: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 7 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 7।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 7ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/purnima.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.purnima: Identify the instantaneous tithi by its one-based number in [15]. For the ordinary calendar day label query that number at local sunrise. Retain every actual matching sunrise and the exact interval even when it falls between sunrises.

meaning.en: The full-Moon day at the end of the bright half of the month.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पक्ष का 15वाँ दिन (पूर्णिमा)।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಕ್ಷದ 15ನೇ ದಿನ (ಹುಣ್ಣಿಮೆ).

glossary/entries/purnimanta.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a calendar convention in which the lunar month ends at the full Moon. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A calendar convention in which the lunar month ends at the full Moon.
meaning.hi: पूर्णिमा पर चंद्र मास समाप्त करने की रीति।
meaning.kn: ಹುಣ್ಣಿಮೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಂದ್ರಮಾಸ ಮುಗಿಯುವ ಪದ್ಧತಿ.

glossary/entries/purva-ashadha.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.purva-ashadha: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 20 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 20।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 20ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/purva-bhadrapada.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.purva-bhadrapada: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 25 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 25।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 25ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/purva-phalguni.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.purva-phalguni: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 11 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 11।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 11ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/pushan.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. Read the linked star entries for the source and any competing assignment. The entrance grid places it at S2.

meaning.en: Pushan is a traditional figure associated with Revati.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पथ के इस हिस्से से जुड़ा पारंपरिक नाम: रेवती।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು: ರೇವತೀ.

glossary/entries/pushya.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.pushya: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 8 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 8।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 8ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/putrakaraka.yaml.admin_note: Select the bound graha only if it holds PK: rank 5 of seven or rank 6 of eight under chara-karakas/methods.yaml. Require a unique rank across the chart uncertainty interval.

meaning.en: The planet assigned to represent children by its place in a ranked list.
meaning.hi: स्थिति के क्रम से संतान का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला ग्रह।
meaning.kn: ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ರಮದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಆಯ್ದ ಗ್ರಹ.

glossary/entries/pythagorean.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a name-reading system that cycles the letters through values from one to nine. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A name-reading system that cycles the letters through values from one to nine.
meaning.hi: अक्षरों को एक से नौ तक बार-बार मान देने की पद्धति।
meaning.kn: ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದರಿಂದ ಒಂಬತ್ತರವರೆಗೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸಿ ನೀಡುವ ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/queen-of-cups-tarot.yam.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on empathetic listening. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank queen in the cups family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में प्याला · रानी की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆ · ರಾಣಿ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/queen-of-pentacles-taro.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on practical care. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank queen in the pentacles family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में मुद्रा · रानी की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಣ್ಯ · ರಾಣಿ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/queen-of-swords-tarot.y.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on clear boundaries. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank queen in the swords family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में तलवार · रानी की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಿ · ರಾಣಿ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/queen-of-wands-tarot.ya.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on warm leadership. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank queen in the wands family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में छड़ी · रानी की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಲು · ರಾಣಿ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/querent.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the person who asks the question used for a reading. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The person who asks the question used for a reading.
meaning.hi: पढ़ाई के लिए सवाल पूछने वाला व्यक्ति।
meaning.kn: ಓದಿಗಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ.

glossary/entries/quincunx.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.aspects.quincunx: For a bound natal pair, accept shortest circular separation within 2 degrees of 150 degrees, inclusive.

meaning.en: Two positions about 150 degrees apart around the sky.
meaning.hi: आकाश के चक्र में लगभग 150 अंश दूर दो स्थान।
meaning.kn: ಆಕಾಶವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 150 ಅಂಶ ದೂರವಿರುವ ಎರಡು ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳು.

glossary/entries/rahu-kalam.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.rahu-kalam: For the local sunrise weekday select j from limbs.yaml day_eighths_sunday_first.rahu. Let D = (sunset − sunrise)/8. Match from sunrise + (j−1)D inclusive until sunrise + jD exclusive.

meaning.en: One of eight parts of daylight selected by weekday and traditionally set aside when choosing a start time.
meaning.hi: दिन के उजाले के आठ हिस्सों में से वार से चुना गया एक हिस्सा।
meaning.kn: ವಾರದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಹಗಲಿನ ಎಂಟು ಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/rahu.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.planets.rahu: Match Rahu when the selected D1 chart point is its computed natal placement.

meaning.en: The point where the Moon crosses the Sun’s apparent path heading north.
meaning.hi: वह बिंदु जहाँ चंद्रमा सूर्य के मार्ग को उत्तर की ओर काटता है।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನು ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಪಥವನ್ನು ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ದಾಟುವ ಬಿಂದು.

glossary/entries/raja-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a named combination traditionally read when considering responsibility and positions of influence. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A named combination traditionally read when considering responsibility and positions of influence.
meaning.hi: जिम्मेदारी और प्रभाव पर विचार करने के लिए देखा जाने वाला मेल।
meaning.kn: ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಭಾವದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನೋಡಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಗ್ರಹ ಸಂಬಂಧ.

glossary/entries/rajju.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a South Indian matching factor that compares the groups assigned to two birth stars. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A South Indian matching factor that compares the groups assigned to two birth stars.
meaning.hi: दक्षिण भारतीय मिलान में जन्म तारों के समूहों की तुलना का पहलू।
meaning.kn: ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತದ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸುವ ಅಂಶ.

glossary/entries/rakshasa-gana.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.gana: Read both natal star classes and look up their ordered temperamental grouping. Labels belong to the table only.

meaning.en: One of the three traditional groups of birth stars, bearing the label Rakshasa.
meaning.hi: जन्म तारों के तीन पारंपरिक समूहों में राक्षस नाम का समूह।
meaning.kn: ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ಮೂರು ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಕ್ಷಸ ಎಂಬ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/rasi-drishti.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for signs are read as connected according to which groups they belong to. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Signs are read as connected according to which groups they belong to.
meaning.hi: राशियों के समूहों के आधार पर उनके बीच माना गया संबंध।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಗಳು ಯಾವ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದರಿಂದ ಅವುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಬಂಧ.

glossary/entries/rasi.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for one of twelve equal sections of the path used to mark positions in the sky. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: One of twelve equal sections of the path used to mark positions in the sky.
meaning.hi: आकाश में स्थिति बताने वाले मार्ग के बारह बराबर भागों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಆಕಾಶದ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ಮಾರ್ಗದ ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/rectification.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a comparison of possible birth times to see which chart fits recorded details most closely. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A comparison of possible birth times to see which chart fits recorded details most closely.
meaning.hi: दर्ज विवरण से सबसे मेल खाते संभावित जन्म समय की तुलना।
meaning.kn: ದಾಖಲಿಸಿದ ವಿವರಗಳಿಗೆ ಯಾವ ಜನನಸಮಯ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಹೋಲಿಕೆ.

glossary/entries/reduction.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for adding the digits of a total again until the chosen stopping rule is reached. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Adding the digits of a total again until the chosen stopping rule is reached.
meaning.hi: तय सीमा तक कुल के अंकों को दोबारा जोड़ना।
meaning.kn: ನಿಗದಿತ ಹಂತದವರೆಗೆ ಮೊತ್ತದ ಅಂಕಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಕೂಡಿಸುವುದು.

glossary/entries/rekha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a stroke used to record a count in some traditional tables. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A stroke used to record a count in some traditional tables.
meaning.hi: कुछ पारंपरिक तालिकाओं में गिनती लिखने का निशान।
meaning.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಣಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ಗೆರೆ.

glossary/entries/relationship-spread.yam.admin_note: Read the positions in order: own-perspective, other-perspective-to-explore, shared-question. The final prompt invites reflection or a chosen action.

meaning.en: Three cards help explore two perspectives and a shared question.
meaning.hi: दो नज़रिए और साझा सवाल देखने के लिए तीन पत्ते।
meaning.kn: ಎರಡು ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ಮೂರು ಪತ್ರಗಳು.

glossary/entries/relocation.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for recalculating the local chart directions for another place while keeping the same moment. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Recalculating the local chart directions for another place while keeping the same moment.
meaning.hi: वही क्षण रखते हुए दूसरी जगह के लिए पत्री की स्थानीय दिशाएँ फिर निकालना।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸ್ಥಳಕ್ಕೆ ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಮರುಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವುದು.

glossary/entries/retrogression.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.transits.retrograde: Within the selected motion interval, signed geocentric longitude speed is negative. At zero do not fire retrograde merely from the instantaneous speed.

meaning.en: A planet appears to move backwards along its usual path when seen from Earth.
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी से ग्रह का पीछे जाता हुआ दिखना।
meaning.kn: ಭೂಮಿಯಿಂದ ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಗ್ರಹ ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಸಾಗಿದಂತೆ ಕಾಣುವುದು.

glossary/entries/revati.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.revati: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 27 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 27।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 27ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/reversal.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a card appearing upside down in a draw, when that option is used. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A card appearing upside down in a draw, when that option is used.
meaning.hi: विकल्प चालू होने पर पढ़ाई में उलटा आया पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಆ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಇದ್ದಾಗ ಪಠಣದಲ್ಲಿ ತಲೆಕೆಳಗಾಗಿ ಬಂದ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/rider-waite-smith.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the illustrated tarot deck named for its publisher, author and artist. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The illustrated tarot deck named for its publisher, author and artist.
meaning.hi: प्रकाशक, लेखक और चित्रकार के नाम से जानी जाने वाली चित्रित टैरो गड्डी।
meaning.kn: ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕ, ಲೇಖಕ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿತ್ರಕಾರರ ಹೆಸರಿನ ಚಿತ್ರಿತ ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಸಮೂಹ.

glossary/entries/rog-choghadiya.yaml.admin_note: This label is slot 7 in the stored day cycle. Look up the weekday-specific start and use the separate night cycle after sunset.

meaning.en: One of seven labels rotated through the eight daytime or nighttime intervals of a weekday.
meaning.hi: दिन या रात के आठ हिस्सों में क्रम से दिए जाने वाले सात नामों में से एक।
meaning.kn: ಹಗಲು ಅಥವಾ ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಎಂಟು ಅವಧಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

glossary/entries/rohini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.rohini: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 4।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 4ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

meaning.hi: कुल के अंकों को बार-बार जोड़ने पर बचा एक अंक।
meaning.kn: ಒಟ್ಟು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಅಂಕಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನಃ ಕೂಡಿಸಿದ ಬಳಿಕ ಉಳಿಯುವ ಒಂದಂಕಿ.

glossary/entries/ruchaka-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Mars occupies a whole-sign angle from Lagna and its own or exaltation sign.

meaning.kn: ಮಂಗಳ ತಾನು ಆಳುವ ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಬಲದ ರಾಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮೂಲೆಯ ಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿರುವುದು.

glossary/entries/ruling-planets.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for planets selected from the time of a question to help check a reading. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: Planets selected from the time of a question to help check a reading.

meaning.hi: ग्रह बल की पूरी इकाई जिसमें साठ छोटी इकाइयाँ होती हैं।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹಬಲದ ಅರವತ್ತು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಘಟಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಮವಾದ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಘಟಕ.

glossary/entries/sade-sati.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.doshas.sade-sati: Within a solved transit interval, Saturn occupies the sign before the natal Moon, its sign, or the following sign. Split intervals at each exit and return.

meaning.en: The time Saturn spends in the sign before, at and after the Moon’s birth sign.
meaning.hi: जन्म की चंद्र राशि से पिछली, उसी और अगली राशि में शनि के जाने का समय।
meaning.kn: ಜನ್ಮದ ಚಂದ್ರರಾಶಿಯ ಹಿಂದಿನ, ಅದೇ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದಿನ ರಾಶಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶನಿ ಸಾಗುವ ಅವಧಿ.

glossary/entries/sadhya-calendar-yoga.ya.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.yoga: Use 1 + floor(((sidereal Moon + sidereal Sun) modulo a turn) / 48000 arcseconds). Select the ordered yoga and solve the bracketing sum-angle crossings.

meaning.en: Interval 22 of 27 found by adding the positions of the Sun and Moon.
meaning.hi: सूर्य और चंद्रमा की जगह जोड़ने से मिलने वाले २७ हिस्सों में क्रम 22।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ೨೭ ಅವಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 22ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

meaning.en: Sign number 9 in the twelve-part circle, covering degrees 240 to 270.

meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರದ 9ನೇ ಭಾಗ, 240ರಿಂದ 270 ಅಂಶಗಳವರೆಗೆ.

glossary/entries/sakata-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Moon lies sixth, eighth or twelfth from Jupiter.

meaning.en: A traditional grouping based on the position of the Moon relative to Jupiter.
meaning.hi: बृहस्पति के सापेक्ष चंद्रमा की स्थिति पर आधारित एक पारंपरिक मेल।
meaning.kn: ಗುರುವಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ.

glossary/entries/samudrika.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for an Indian tradition that gives symbolic readings of visible features, including the hand. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An Indian tradition that gives symbolic readings of visible features, including the hand.
meaning.hi: हाथ सहित दिखाई देने वाली बनावट को प्रतीक की तरह पढ़ने की भारतीय परंपरा।
meaning.kn: ಕೈ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಕಾಣುವ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಂಕೇತಿಕವಾಗಿ ಓದುವ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಪರಂಪರೆ.

glossary/entries/sankata-yogini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-yogini.balance-calculation: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

meaning.en: A period lasting 8 years in the repeating 36-year sequence.
meaning.hi: ३६ वर्ष के चक्र में 8 वर्ष की अवधि।
meaning.kn: ೩೬ ವರ್ಷದ ಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ 8 ವರ್ಷ ಇರುವ ಅವಧಿ.

glossary/entries/sankranti.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.sankranti: Match the sunrise day containing a solved forward sidereal solar crossing of an integer multiple of 30 degrees. Bind the entered sign and crossing instant.

meaning.en: The Sun’s entry into a new sign.
meaning.hi: सूर्य का नई राशि में प्रवेश।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯ ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ರಾಶಿಗೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುವುದು.

glossary/entries/saptami.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.tithi: At the query instant compute E = (Moon − Sun) modulo 1296000 arcseconds. The public number is 1 + floor(E / 43200); use the zero-based quotient for indexing only. Resolve name and paksha in limb-tables.yaml and bracket the two true crossings as specified in limbs.yaml.

meaning.en: Lunar day 7 of a fortnight, measured by the changing distance of the Moon from the Sun.
meaning.hi: चंद्र पक्ष का 7वाँ दिन।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರಪಕ್ಷದ 7ನೇ ದಿನ.

glossary/entries/saptavargaja.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.saptavargaja: Sum the seven unweighted dignity awards. In D1 first test the KB-02 half-open moolatrikona interval. Next test sign ownership in each varga. Otherwise combine the target’s natural relation to its sign lord (+1, 0, −1) with its temporary relation (+1 for the specified D1 sign distances from target to lord, −1 otherwise). Index the relationship awards by the sum plus two. Use natural relationships from KB-02 and classical sign lords and divisions from KB-11.

meaning.en: A strength contribution based on positions in seven related charts.
meaning.hi: सात संबंधित पत्रियों की स्थितियों से निकला बल।
meaning.kn: ಏಳು ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಿಂದ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಬಲ.

meaning.en: A traditional pattern involving the ruler associated with change and shared resources.
meaning.hi: बदलाव और साझा संसाधन के क्षेत्र के स्वामी से जुड़ा पारंपरिक मेल।
meaning.kn: ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ಅಧಿಪತಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ.

glossary/entries/saraswati-yoga.yaml.admin_note: Mercury, Venus and Jupiter each occupy house 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9 or 10 from Lagna. Jupiter also meets its strength minimum in an own, exaltation or naturally friendly sign.

meaning.hi: बुध, शुक्र और गुरु का चुनी जगहों में होना और गुरु का बल की शर्त पूरी करना।
meaning.kn: ಬುಧ, ಶುಕ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಗುರು ಆಯ್ದ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಲ್ಲಿದ್ದು ಗುರು ಬಲದ ಷರತ್ತನ್ನೂ ಪೂರೈಸುವುದು.

glossary/entries/sarpa.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. Read the linked star entries for the source and any competing assignment. Select the star using its measured span.

glossary/entries/sarvashtakavarga.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-ashtakavarga.sarvashtakavarga: Add the seven unreduced planetary BAV rows column by column, Aries through Pisces. The twelve sign totals sum to 337. Lagna supplies marks in each row.

meaning.kn: ಏಳು ಗ್ರಹಗಳ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕಗಳ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ರಾಶಿವಾರು ಸೇರಿಸುವ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ.

glossary/entries/sesquiquadrate.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.aspects.sesquiquadrate: The selected natal pair forms the named aspect within its configured orb.

glossary/entries/seven-of-cups-tarot.yam.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on many possibilities. What comes to mind in this position?

glossary/entries/seven-of-pentacles-taro.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on patient cultivation. What comes to mind in this position?

glossary/entries/shadbala-minimum.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.totals: Sum the six signed components in virupas and divide by sixty for rupas. Compare the unrounded result with the graha minimum using greater-than-or-equal. Separately compute Ishta = sqrt(U × C) and Kashta = sqrt((60 − U) × (60 − C)), where U is Uchcha and C is the selected undoubled Cheshta in [0,60]. Neither phala enters the total. If any required input is unknown, withhold the dependent result.

meaning.en: The traditional comparison level for the six-part strength calculation of one planet.
meaning.hi: एक ग्रह के छह बलों के कुल की तुलना का पारंपरिक स्तर।

glossary/entries/shodhya-pinda.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-ashtakavarga.shodhya-pinda: For each target, multiply each fully reduced sign value by its rashi weight and sum. glossary/entries/siddha-yogini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-yogini.balance-calculation: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

meaning.en: A period lasting 7 years in the repeating 36-year sequence.
