meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में मुद्रा · छह की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಣ್ಯ · ಆರು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/six-of-swords-tarot.yam.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on a calmer transition. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank six in the swords family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में तलवार · छह की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಿ · ಆರು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/six-of-wands-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on recognition. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank six in the wands family of the deck.
meaning.hi: टैरो की गड्डी में छड़ी · छह की पहचान वाला पत्ता।
meaning.kn: ಟ್ಯಾರೊ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಲು · ಆರು ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/solar-arc.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a timing method that advances chart points by the same distance as the progressed Sun. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A timing method that advances chart points by the same distance as the progressed Sun.
meaning.hi: आगे बढ़ाए सूर्य जितनी दूरी से सभी स्थान आगे करने की समय विधि।
meaning.kn: ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಿದ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಅಂತರದಷ್ಟೇ ಇತರ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನೂ ಮುಂದೆ ಸರಿಸುವ ಕಾಲವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/solar-return.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.returns.solar-return: Solve the annual ascending crossing of the unwrapped tropical solar longitude at the natal solar longitude plus an integral turn near the requested anniversary. Cast for the location at the return instant; compare return angles and Sun house with the natal chart. Without a reliable location omit houses and angles.

meaning.en: A chart for the moment the Sun returns to its position at birth.
meaning.hi: सूर्य के जन्म वाली जगह लौटने के पल की पत्री।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯನು ಜನನದ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳುವ ಕ್ಷಣದ ನಕ್ಷೆ.

glossary/entries/sookshma.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a fine time interval obtained by dividing a third-level period again. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A fine time interval obtained by dividing a third-level period again.
meaning.hi: तीसरे स्तर की अवधि का और छोटा हिस्सा।
meaning.kn: ಮೂರನೇ ಹಂತದ ಅವಧಿಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಭಾಗಿಸಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಅವಧಿ.

glossary/entries/soul-urge.yaml.admin_note: Application in numerology.pythagorean.soul-urge: Sum A E I O U in the confirmed spelling and reduce. Y belongs to the consonants under the fixed profile. An empty vowel partition is unavailable.

meaning.en: A number found using only the vowels in a name.
meaning.hi: नाम के केवल स्वरों के मान से बनी संख्या।
meaning.kn: ಹೆಸರಿನ ಸ್ವರಗಳ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಂದ ಮಾತ್ರ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

glossary/entries/spread.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for an arrangement of cards in which each place has its own question or purpose. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An arrangement of cards in which each place has its own question or purpose.
meaning.hi: पत्तों की ऐसी बनावट जिसमें हर जगह का अपना सवाल या उद्देश्य होता है।
meaning.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೂ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಅಥವಾ ಉದ್ದೇಶವಿರುವ ಇಸ್ಪೀಟಿನ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಜೋಡಣೆ.

glossary/entries/square-palm-mark.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Four strokes enclosing a small quadrangle.
meaning.hi: चार रेखाओं से घिरा छोटा चौकोर भाग।
meaning.kn: ಚತುರ್ಭುಜ ರೂಪಿಸುವ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗೆರೆಗಳು.

term.hi: चार रेखाओं से घिरा छोटा चौकोर भाग

glossary/entries/square.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.aspects.square: For a bound natal pair, accept shortest circular separation within 6 degrees of 90 degrees, inclusive.

meaning.en: Two positions about 90 degrees apart around the sky.
meaning.hi: आकाश के चक्र में लगभग 90 अंश दूर दो स्थान।
meaning.kn: ಆಕಾಶವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 90 ಅಂಶ ದೂರವಿರುವ ಎರಡು ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳು.

glossary/entries/sripati.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a way of spacing the centres of houses between four main chart directions. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A way of spacing the centres of houses between four main chart directions.
meaning.hi: चार मुख्य दिशाओं के बीच घरों के केंद्र रखने की विधि।
meaning.kn: ನಾಲ್ಕು ಮುಖ್ಯ ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಮನೆಗಳ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಇಡುವ ವಿಧಾನ.

glossary/entries/star-lord.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the planet assigned to the star section where a point falls. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The planet assigned to the star section where a point falls.
meaning.hi: बिंदु जिस तारा खंड में है उससे जुड़ा ग्रह।
meaning.kn: ಬಿಂದು ಇರುವ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಗದಿಯಾದ ಗ್ರಹ.

glossary/entries/star-palm-mark.yaml.admin_note: Use the illustration for the selected physical hand. The reader reports their own choice. The linked entries distinguish left and right.

meaning.en: Several strokes meeting at one point.
meaning.hi: एक बिंदु पर मिलती कई रेखाएँ।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರುವ ಹಲವು ಗೆರೆಗಳು.

term.hi: एक बिंदु पर मिलती कई रेखाएँ

glossary/entries/station.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.transits.station: At a solved instant with zero longitudinal speed, the signs of the neighboring nonzero speeds must differ. A small nonzero speed alone does not qualify.

meaning.en: The turning point when a planet appears to change between forward and backward motion.
meaning.hi: वह मोड़ जहाँ ग्रह की दिखाई देने वाली चाल आगे या पीछे बदलती है।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹದ ಚಲನೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹಿಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗುವಂತೆ ಕಾಣುವ ತಿರುವು.

glossary/entries/stellium.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.patterns.stellium: Group at least three distinct natal planets in one tropical sign, returning one maximal group per sign. Schools also use four planets, house clusters or a chain of conjunctions.

meaning.en: A cluster of several planets in one part of a chart.
meaning.hi: पत्री के एक हिस्से में कई ग्रहों का समूह।
meaning.kn: ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಒಂದೇ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ಗ್ರಹಗಳ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/sthana-bala.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.sthana: Sum the five positional contributions in virupas without intermediate rounding.

meaning.en: The part of a planet’s traditional strength calculated from where it is placed.
meaning.hi: ग्रह की जगह से निकाला जाने वाला बल का हिस्सा।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹ ಇರುವ ಸ್ಥಾನದಿಂದ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವ ಬಲದ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/stree-deergha.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a matching factor that checks the forward distance between the two birth stars. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A matching factor that checks the forward distance between the two birth stars.
meaning.hi: एक जन्म तारे से दूसरे तक आगे की ओर दूरी की जाँच।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷತ್ರದಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದರವರೆಗಿನ ಮುಂದಿನ ಅಂತರದ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ.

glossary/entries/strength-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on patient courage. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: A named picture card, numbered 8, used as a prompt for reflection.
meaning.hi: चिंतन के लिए चित्र वाला पत्ता, जिसका क्रमांक 8 है।
meaning.kn: ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ 8 ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಚಿತ್ರಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/sugriva.yaml.admin_note: This name identifies the symbolic attribution in the cited KB table. The entrance grid places it at W3.

meaning.en: The traditional name for entrance position W3 in the building plan.
meaning.hi: भवन के नक्शे में प्रवेश की जगह W3 का पारंपरिक नाम।
meaning.kn: ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ W3 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಹೆಸರು.

glossary/entries/sukarma-calendar-yoga.y.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.yoga: Use 1 + floor(((sidereal Moon + sidereal Sun) modulo a turn) / 48000 arcseconds). Select the ordered yoga and solve the bracketing sum-angle crossings.

meaning.en: Interval 7 of 27 found by adding the positions of the Sun and Moon.
meaning.hi: सूर्य और चंद्रमा की जगह जोड़ने से मिलने वाले २७ हिस्सों में क्रम 7।
meaning.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ೨೭ ಅವಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 7ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/sun-line.yaml.admin_note: Application in palmistry.lines.sun-right: The user confirmed the illustrated choice on the right hand: Upright crease toward the ring finger.

meaning.en: A crease running towards the base of the ring finger.
meaning.hi: अनामिका की जड़ की ओर जाती रेखा।
meaning.kn: ಉಂಗುರದ ಬೆರಳಿನ ಬುಡದತ್ತ ಸಾಗುವ ಗೆರೆ.

glossary/entries/sun.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.planets.sun: The selected tropical natal body is sun. Read its sign as a style and its house as an area of experience.

meaning.en: The star at the centre of our solar system.
meaning.hi: सौरमंडल के केंद्र का तारा।
meaning.kn: ಸೌರವ್ಯೂಹದ ಕೇಂದ್ರದ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/sunapha-yoga.yaml.admin_note: At least one of Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn occupies the second sign(s) counted from the natal Moon; for both sides require a separate occupant on each.

meaning.en: One of five eligible planets occupies the sign after the Moon.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा से अगली राशि में पाँच पात्र ग्रहों में से कोई एक होना।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಮುಂದಿನ ರಾಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಐದು ಅರ್ಹ ಗ್ರಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಇರುವುದು.

glossary/entries/swamsa.yaml.admin_note: Application in jaimini.karakamsa.swamsa: Bind the requested swamsa convention. In the sutra-commentary reading use the AK’s D9 sign; in the lagnamsa reading use the D9 sign of the birth ascendant. Use the KB-11 Navamsa lookup and only D9 occupants. An unspecified convention yields unknown.

meaning.en: A reference point in the nine-part chart whose exact use depends on the chosen school.
meaning.hi: नौ भागों वाली पत्री में परंपरा के अनुसार चुना गया आरंभ बिंदु।
meaning.kn: ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಭಾಗಗಳ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಆಯ್ದ ಆರಂಭದ ಬಿಂದು.

glossary/entries/swati.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.nakshatras.swati: Match the stable natal Moon nakshatra when its sidereal longitude falls in the recorded half-open span.

meaning.en: Section 15 of the 27 equal parts used to locate the Moon along its path.
meaning.hi: चंद्रमा की जगह बताने वाले २७ बराबर हिस्सों में क्रम 15।
meaning.kn: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ೨೭ ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 15ನೇ ಭಾಗ.

glossary/entries/swords.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for the tarot suit pictured with blades, often used to explore thought and communication. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: The tarot suit pictured with blades, often used to explore thought and communication.
meaning.hi: सोच और बातचीत पर विचार करने वाला तलवार चिह्न का पत्ता समूह।
meaning.kn: ವಿಚಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂವಹನವನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಕತ್ತಿ ಗುರುತಿನ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪು.

glossary/entries/synastry.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a comparison of two birth charts to explore how people may relate. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A comparison of two birth charts to explore how people may relate.
meaning.hi: दो लोगों के संबंध पर विचार के लिए उनकी जन्मपत्रियों की तुलना।
meaning.kn: ಇಬ್ಬರ ಸಂಬಂಧದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯೋಚಿಸಲು ಮಾಡುವ ಎರಡು ಜನ್ಮನಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ಹೋಲಿಕೆ.

glossary/entries/synodic-month.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.tithi: At the query instant compute E = (Moon − Sun) modulo 1296000 arcseconds. The public number is 1 + floor(E / 43200); use the zero-based quotient for indexing only. Resolve name and paksha in limb-tables.yaml and bracket the two true crossings as specified in limbs.yaml.

meaning.en: The time from one new Moon to the next.
meaning.hi: एक अमावस्या से अगली तक का समय।
meaning.kn: ಒಂದು ಅಮಾವಾಸ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಮುಂದಿನ ಅಮಾವಾಸ್ಯೆಯವರೆಗಿನ ಅವಧಿ.

glossary/entries/t-square.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.patterns.t-square: Two endpoints oppose one another and a third, the apex, squares both. Test all three edges.

meaning.en: Two opposite positions are each about a quarter-circle from a third position.
meaning.hi: दो आमने-सामने जगहों से तीसरी जगह लगभग चौथाई चक्र दूर होती है।
meaning.kn: ಎದುರುಬದುರಿನ ಎರಡು ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಿಂದ ಮೂರನೇ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಸುಮಾರು ಕಾಲು ಸುತ್ತಿನ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಜೋಡಣೆ.

glossary/entries/taitila.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.panchang.karana: Use floor(((Moon − Sun) modulo a turn) / 21600 arcseconds). Use the fixed index map at 0 and 57–59; for 1–56 use movable[(index−1) modulo 7]. Solve the flanking 6° crossings.

meaning.en: A half lunar day named in a repeating seven-part sequence.
meaning.hi: सात नामों के दोहराते क्रम का एक आधा चंद्र दिन।
meaning.kn: ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಕ್ರಮದ ಒಂದು ಅರ್ಧ ತಿಥಿ.

glossary/entries/tajika.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for an Indian tradition that reads yearly charts and questions using relationships between planets. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: An Indian tradition that reads yearly charts and questions using relationships between planets.
meaning.hi: ग्रहों के संबंध से वर्षपत्री और सवाल पढ़ने की परंपरा।
meaning.kn: ಗ್ರಹಗಳ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳಿಂದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಓದುವ ಪರಂಪರೆ.

glossary/entries/tara-bala.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.muhurta.check-big-decision-muhurta-tara-support: Specific participant has a supportive birth-star distance in the candidate interval.

meaning.en: A comparison between the Moon’s section at birth and its section on a chosen day.
meaning.hi: जन्म और चुने हुए दिन में चंद्रमा किन खंडों में है, इसकी तुलना।
meaning.kn: ಜನನದ ಚಂದ್ರನ ವಿಭಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ಆಯ್ದ ದಿನದ ಚಂದ್ರನ ವಿಭಾಗದ ಹೋಲಿಕೆ.

glossary/entries/tara.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.matching.tara: Count birth stars inclusively in both directions. Add the two remainder lookups, using zero for multiples of nine.

meaning.en: A matching factor based on the distance counted between two birth stars.
meaning.hi: दो जन्म तारों के बीच की दूरी गिनने का पहलू।
meaning.kn: ಇಬ್ಬರ ಜನ್ಮ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸುವ ಅಂಶ.

glossary/entries/tarot.yaml.admin_note: Use this label for a set of picture cards arranged and read as prompts for reflection. Read the linked entries for the applicable conditions and differences between methods.

meaning.en: A set of picture cards arranged and read as prompts for reflection.
meaning.hi: चित्र वाले पत्तों को सजाकर चिंतन के लिए पढ़ने की विधि।
meaning.kn: ಚಿತ್ರಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಪದ್ಧತಿ.

glossary/entries/taurus.yaml.admin_note: Application in western.signs.taurus: The selected tropical point falls in [30, 60) degrees from the March equinox. Fixed earth; modern ruler venus, traditional ruler venus.

meaning.en: Sign number 2 in the twelve-part circle, covering degrees 30 to 60.
meaning.hi: बारह राशियों में क्रम 2, 30 से 60 अंश तक।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಚಕ್ರದ 2ನೇ ಭಾಗ, 30ರಿಂದ 60 ಅಂಶಗಳವರೆಗೆ.

glossary/entries/temperance-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on a workable balance. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: A named picture card, numbered 14, used as a prompt for reflection.
meaning.hi: चिंतन के लिए चित्र वाला पत्ता, जिसका क्रमांक 14 है।
meaning.kn: ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ 14 ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಚಿತ್ರಪತ್ರ.

glossary/entries/ten-of-cups-tarot.yaml.admin_note: Deck identity is shared by both orientations. Upright reflection: You may wish to reflect on shared happiness. What comes to mind in this position?

meaning.en: The card of rank ten in the cups family of the deck.

glossary/entries/ulka-yogini.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.dashas-yogini.balance-calculation: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

meaning.en: A period lasting 6 years in the repeating 36-year sequence.
meaning.hi: ३६ वर्ष के चक्र में 6 वर्ष की अवधि।

meaning.en: A matching factor that compares animal symbols assigned to birth stars.
meaning.hi: जन्म तारों के पशु प्रतीकों की तुलना का पहलू।

glossary/entries/yuddha-bala.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.strength-shadbala.yuddha: For each eligible pair with shorter separation strictly below one degree, compare the signed ecliptic latitudes per KB-05. Transfer the absolute difference of their pre-war Kala amounts to the northern graha from the southern graha. The pre-war amount is the sum of the other eight Kala terms. Accumulate disjoint pairs simultaneously. Withhold affected results for an unresolved winner or overlapping pairs.

meaning.en: A strength adjustment applied to two eligible planets in a very close meeting.
meaning.hi: बहुत पास आए दो पात्र ग्रहों के बल में किया जाने वाला समायोजन।
meaning.kn: ತುಂಬ ಹತ್ತಿರವಿರುವ ಎರಡು ಅರ್ಹ ಗ್ರಹಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಬಲದ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ.

glossary/entries/yuva-age-state.yaml.admin_note: Application in vedic.states.baladi: Divide the graha’s natal sign into five successive six-degree intervals. Read the odd-sign order from Aries onward by sign parity and reverse the order in even signs. Normalize 30 degrees to the next sign before lookup.

meaning.en: A symbolic stage described as fully active when a planet falls in the corresponding part of a sign.
meaning.hi: राशि में जगह से तय प्रतीकात्मक अवस्था: पूरी सक्रियता।
meaning.kn: ರಾಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಂಕೇತಿಕ ಹಂತ: ಪೂರ್ಣ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ.

life-areas/conflict-ladder.yaml.boundaries: Western and Numerology remain in separate sections and never vote. Western positions are tropical. After rung seven Bhava Bala may order otherwise equal candidates only. KB-48 clamps the final grade after rung eight.
life-areas/conflict-ladder.yaml.policy: Resolve a conflict at the earliest applicable rung. Apply distinct remaining evidence once. Resolve cancellations and softening before the ladder. Unknown has no adverse vote.

rungs.effect: Only an uncancelled yoga activated by the Maha or Antar participates; inactive or unproved activation is background.
Use the KB-35 chart-specific polarity for lordship; keep natural nature separate.
Some Weak participants make the yoga mild; all Weak removes it.

Strong D1 plus debilitated/enemy D9 and no vargottama steps down. A Weak individual lord can receive limited confirmation only after the area passes the D1 promise floor. A Weak D1 area never produces a card from divisional evidence.
Agreeing directional Lagna and Moon testimonies raise one step. In disagreement Lagna governs events and Moon experience. Missing testimony cannot confirm.
Combine confirming and contradicting KP/Jaimini votes to at most one net step. No standalone card.
Remaining equally primary support and caution yield Moderate with mixed signals.

period.significators: Owners and occupants of the target house, full aspectors of the house or lord, and area karakas. Add grahas in the stars of those direct significators once, without transitive expansion.

promise.arithmetic: MODERN/POPULAR Bhava360 bands, counted without rescaling for absent evidence.
factors: Area lord Strong or Moderate in the KB-35 grade.
At least one functional Benefic or Yogakaraka and no functionally Malefic occupant with a Weak grade. Empty is unscored.
Full functional benefic aspects to house and lord outnumber malefic aspects. Count each source and distinct target once.
Strict majority of the recipe karakas grade Strong or Moderate.
Repeat the first three tests in the Moon chart; at least two pass. Functional polarity still requires the actual Lagna.
The D9 lord has own/exalted/MT/friendly dignity or vargottama. For career also require the D10 lord in an angle/trine or own/exalted sign.
promise.missing: Drop withheld or undecidable factors. Never count them as adverse. Weak stops here before searching dates.
promise.tradition: CLASSICAL Parashari lordship, occupants, aspects, karakas and divisional confirmation.
promise.varga_gate: Require at least Moderate D1 promise before divisional confirmation can contribute.

life-areas/pipeline.yaml.scope: Bind one chart, area recipe and interval. Resolve the area in life-areas/recipes.yaml, including its release flags and sensitivity settings. Apply matched bhanga and softening to the bound graha before counting any factor.

sources.locator: Natal promise and period results (passage pending)

transit.method: At each reference test Jupiter and Saturn independently for occupation or full aspect of the area sign or the natal sign of its lord. Keep both reference results; Lagna confirms an event, Moon describes experience. Tier C has no event window.
transit.tradition: MODERN/POPULAR double transit; classical full aspects and Ashtakavarga tables.
transit.variant: The older low-bindu grade deduction is inactive. Pace only orders windows.

window.bounds: Intersect query horizon, active Antar, eligible Tier A Pratyantar and continuous double-transit segments as half-open intervals. Exclude zero duration.
window.ordering: First card uses earliest start. Later windows put supported before slower, then date; use period weights only to break otherwise equal choices.
window.peaks: In Tier A Mars or Sun occupying either natal target marks the month. The Moon marks days only inside a window starting in the next thirty days. Apply KB-48 stability to every displayed date.

activities.selection: Rank leading-area choices then compatible star group then tithi preference. Under Chandrashtama, Janma or adverse Tara, or Rikta defer starting-work and travel ahead of other suggestions. Exclude duplicates between lists. Offer only matched activities.

best_time.polar: Withhold sunrise-dependent times when sunrise or sunset is absent. Independently resolved Vishti still appears in the civil-day exclusions.
best_time.selection: Clip to local sunrise and sunset, omit Wednesday Abhijit, subtract every hard exclusion and keep spans of at least fifteen minutes. Prefer candidate order then longest span then earliest start.

antar.method: If the Antar lord owns or fully aspects the transit Moon sign then its owned life areas lead activity choices. Withheld lord or owned areas give no focus.

chandra.method: Count signs inclusively from natal Moon. Eligible obstruction neutralises a favourable Moon house.

sav.method: Withhold at Tier C and whenever KB-48 withholds SAV. Use per-sign raw SAV with the Raman/Santhanam Moon contributor row. Below threshold is neutral.

tara.method: Reuse inclusive nine-star cycle. Janma neutrality is the daily editorial default.

modules/home/day.yaml.provenance: Classical Chandra, Tara and SAV inputs. Direction aggregation and activity ordering are MODERN/POPULAR editorial policy.
modules/home/day.yaml.scope: Bind active person, local civil date and timing city. Apply KB-48 stability to each dependency independently. Unknown inputs have no adverse vote.
modules/home/day.yaml.tomorrow: One sentence if the tone changes or a fast ingress or station occurs. Otherwise omit.

modules/home/month.yaml.background: Jupiter and Saturn have no month vote. Saturn in the twelfth, first or second sign from natal Moon uses only the gentle phase copy in copy.yaml. Add the support qualifier at Saturn-sign SAV of at least 28 and the timing qualifier for a functionally Benefic or Yogakaraka Antar.
modules/home/month.yaml.coming_up: Distinct dated sankranti, fast-mover ingress/station and Antar boundaries inside the month. Sort by local date then this category order, maximum three.
modules/home/month.yaml.phase_qualifiers: Saturn as Yogakaraka or Lagna lord, Saturn own BAV at least four, or eligible Saturn-sign SAV can qualify the background. Withhold Lagna-dependent qualifiers at Tier C. Antar qualifier remains distinct.
modules/home/month.yaml.reference: Natal Moon. Split intervals at ingress, vedha changes and local month boundaries. Use elapsed duration including any time withheld. First select a house occupied for more than half the full month. Within it select the effective stance for more than half that stay. Withhold an uncertain stance from the count; ties are neutral.
modules/home/month.yaml.sun: Record sankranti date and the new inclusive house. Evaluate the Sun over the whole month by duration like the other fast movers.
modules/home/month.yaml.tone_policy: Sun and at least two others supportive gives Supportive. Sun and at least two others caution gives Take care. Otherwise Steady. Blocked favourable means neutral.

modules/home/week.yaml.days: Evaluate day.yaml separately for each local date from Monday through Sunday with that day's city and stable natal Moon.
modules/home/week.yaml.headline: One headline. Prefer a dated Maha or Antar boundary, then the first change in effective fast-mover testimony (Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars in order; apply vedha). Otherwise describe continuity. Preserve all seven daily tones.

modules/matching/composition.yaml.inputs: Use both consented profiles and selected matching system.
modules/matching/composition.yaml.output: Show factor explanations, qualitative themes, exceptions and practices for discussing differences.

modules/notifications/composition.yaml.inputs: Read consent, quiet hours, current zone and reminder type.
modules/notifications/composition.yaml.output: Send local Today, festival, optional tarot or timing items from active facts; respect the daily non-reminder cap.

modules/planning/composition.yaml.inputs: Read selected activity, city, range and participants.
modules/planning/composition.yaml.output: Present exclusion-free windows with factors, add-to-calendar and local reminders.

modules/reports/composition.yaml.inputs: Use current facts, report type, active profile version and release flag.
modules/reports/composition.yaml.output: Compose chapters with dated evidence; annual placements need annual engine. Matching needs two consenting profiles. Exclude paid health books.

modules/timeline/composition.yaml.inputs: Load full nested dasha intervals and personal transit windows.
modules/timeline/composition.yaml.output: Sort past, present and upcoming chapters by actual start time; handle boundary instant once.

copy.evidence: Every personal statement must resolve to supplied facts. Mark each AI-written sentence with ✦ AI.
copy.houses: Use localized life-area wording in consumer output. Restrict house numbers to admin/tester evidence.
copy.matching: Show qualitative factor explanations. Raw matching totals, points and percentages are restricted to admin/tester evidence.
copy.reading_footer_en: Guidance for reflection, not a guarantee. Not medical, financial or legal advice.
copy.reflection_line_en: For reflection. You choose what to do.
copy.sensitive_routing: Route to approved localized boundary messages. For self-harm use the support flow with current verified resources.
copy.style: Use gentle possibilities and practical choices. Exclude guarantees, fear, pressure, scores and colour-only signals.

inputs.ai: With consent, allow first name and minimum derived evidence only. Exclude contact details, raw identifiers, exact coordinates and raw images from text prompts.
inputs.chart: Bind the active profile, birth-time precision, convention, date and relevant place.
inputs.face: On-device only with immediate photo deletion. Exclude sensitive-trait inference.
inputs.fixtures: Synthetic only, excluded from production retrieval.
inputs.mobile_and_vehicle: Process raw numbers in memory. Never log or send them to AI. Persist only by explicit save.
inputs.palm: Separate reading consent and confirmed illustrated choices only. Future photo input is disabled by default and requires separate explicit consent. Default retention is zero days.
inputs.timing: Use the current timing city or label the fallback. Preserve the original natal instant and place.

health.en: For health questions, a qualified clinician can help you decide what care you need.
health.hi: स्वास्थ्य से जुड़े सवालों में योग्य चिकित्सक देखभाल तय करने में मदद कर सकते हैं।
health.kn: ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಹ ವೈದ್ಯರು ಸೂಕ್ತ ಆರೈಕೆ ಆರಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು.

immediate-support.kn: ನೀವು ನಿಮಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ಅನಿಸಿದರೆ ಈಗಲೇ ಹತ್ತಿರದವರ ನೆರವು ಪಡೆದು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ತುರ್ತು ಸೇವೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ.

shared/boundaries/responses.yaml.support_route: Self-harm signals bypass all reading engines. Show the reviewed local support directory for the user’s country.

interval.finite: Use the declared radius in time.yaml unless assessment_radius_seconds is specified. Include both limits around the resolved UTC instant.
interval.unknown: Use the entire local civil date in the resolved IANA zone, from its start up to but excluding the next date. Local noon is only the working instant.

rectification.mvp: Every record uses the declared precision. Past-event input alone cannot raise a tier.

stability.lagna_edge: Within about one degree of a sign boundary, check whether the crossing actually lies in the interval.
stability.moon_edge: Within about one degree of a nakshatra boundary, check the actual crossing before admitting a starting lord or dependent dates.
stability.precedence: A changing, missing or unproved dependency withholds the output. Stability cannot restore a tier-hidden output.
stability.proof: Require complete transition coverage for each bound fact throughout its interval. Equal samples at the endpoints alone cannot establish stability.
stability.unproved: Omit the dependent evidence. An omitted promise factor supplies no adverse vote.
stability.varga_edge: Check every interpreting sign including the divisional Lagna across the wider of the tier interval and the minimum varga interval.

traditions_differ.alternative: Tier A except D60, D40, D45, KP cusp sub-lords and derived cusp outputs, and Pratyantar/Sookshma windows, subject to every stability gate.

approximate.en: Your birth time is approximate. You can explore the parts of the reading that stay the same across that time.
approximate.hi: आपका जन्म समय अनुमानित है। आप पाठ के उन हिस्सों को देख सकते हैं जो उस अवधि में एक जैसे रहते हैं।
approximate.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜನನ ಸಮಯ ಅಂದಾಜಿನದು. ಆ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ ರೀತಿ ಉಳಿಯುವ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಬಹುದು.

full.en: Your birth time can support a detailed reading. Some details may be left out if they change around that time.
full.hi: आपके जन्म समय के आधार पर विस्तृत पाठ दिया जा सकता है। उस समय के आसपास बदलने वाले कुछ विवरण छोड़े जा सकते हैं।
full.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜನನ ಸಮಯದ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರವಾದ ಓದನ್ನು ನೀಡಬಹುದು. ಆ ಸಮಯದ ಸುತ್ತ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಕೆಲವು ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಬಹುದು.

moon-approximate.en: With an approximate birth time, you can explore the parts of a Moon-sign reading that stay consistent around that time.
moon-approximate.hi: अनुमानित जन्म समय के आसपास चंद्र राशि पर आधारित जो बातें एक जैसी रहती हैं, आप उन पर विचार कर सकते हैं।
moon-approximate.kn: ಅಂದಾಜು ಜನನ ಸಮಯದ ಸುತ್ತ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುವ ಚಂದ್ರರಾಶಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಬಹುದು.

moon-unknown.en: Without a birth time, you can explore the parts of a Moon-sign reading that stay consistent through the day.
moon-unknown.hi: जन्म समय मालूम न होने पर आप चंद्र राशि पर आधारित वे बातें देख सकते हैं जो पूरे दिन एक जैसी रहती हैं।
moon-unknown.kn: ಜನನ ಸಮಯ ತಿಳಿದಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ, ದಿನವಿಡೀ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುವ ಚಂದ್ರರಾಶಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಬಹುದು.

actions.cap-moderate: Clamp the final stable card grade after the conflict ladder. Preserve lower grades and the internal KB-35 worksheet.
actions.hide: Omit the output and any evidence depending on it.
actions.month-resolution: Compare each bound at calendar-month precision. Show months only when all possible bounds agree at that resolution.
actions.show: Eligible only when the output and all material dependencies are proved stable.

shared/confidence/output-matrix.yaml.binding: Resolve each dependency for the selected planet, house, query, period, convention and local reporting zone. Apply the same stability check to the actual output and its material inputs.
shared/confidence/output-matrix.yaml.dates: Compare dates or months in the same reporting zone. Event windows in B use the Antar bounds without a peak. Never promote a working noon instant to a known event time.
shared/confidence/output-matrix.yaml.promise: Apply the gate to each factor independently. Insufficient evidence is unknown. A dependent factor inherits the full restrictions of its source, including a hidden D24 or unstable D10.

ambiguity.spring_forward: Reject the missing civil time and ask for a valid local time.

shared/conventions/time.yaml.india_wartime: Use Asia/Kolkata history including the 1942–45 wartime changes. Never apply a fixed modern IST offset to those dates.

pre_standard.record: Retain the historical zone, offset in seconds and origin label. An explicit offset is a user observation, never a second source of zone rules.

shared/conventions/time.yaml.stability: For a nonzero uncertainty interval include both endpoints and every intervening transition. Withhold precise birth-dependent event instants and any changing or unproved classification, including sign, house, nakshatra, pada, varga and period lord. Noon positions are working estimates only. Missing place or unresolved civil time withholds all instant-dependent facts.

admin: internal reading evidence and area relevance
functional polarity and private planet-grade worksheet
shared/explain/payload.yaml.copy_identity: Resolve copy_aliases only for the identical localized user_text. Keep the matched school's rule, conditions, calculations and provenance.
shared/explain/payload.yaml.evidence_identity: After matching, resolve evidence_aliases before collecting evidence for the same chart, person, placement and dated interval. Prefer the canonical reading when both IDs match. Keep the requested ID, applicable life area and historical wording in the audit record.
public: personal meaning constrained to matched evidence
actual start and end instants when relevant
shared/explain/payload.yaml.synthesis_chips: Project only translated area, active-period, timing and actionable pace explanations from matched evidence. Exclude counts, grades, house numbers and rule IDs. Suppressed factors produce no chip.
shared/explain/payload.yaml.unavailable: Show the reason when precision or evidence is insufficient.

order: Resolve the matched rule and its exceptions. Drop cancellations and unavailable facts. Deduplicate evidence aliases.
Apply the direction for the matched technique. A variable checker relation comes from its approved recipe; sign placement friendship uses the directed fivefold D1 relationship.

At KB-36 rung 3 replace the generic direction of evidence specifically about a graha's lordship with the functional polarity for this Lagna. Preserve the replaced direction in staff provenance. Unresolved polarity contributes context.
For a house aspect resolve its caster by functional nature. An aspect to its own sign protects the house. An unknown caster supplies context only.
Use area_strength to select relevance. Primary indications can anchor a reading; secondary indications corroborate; a modifier needs its parent. Context cannot establish a tone, even if repeated.
Present the resolved qualitative tone only after the pipeline's required checks. No rule-level points, polarity flags or grade arithmetic cross the public boundary.
shared/explain/tone-contribution.yaml.policy: Bhava360 editorial evidence routing. Evaluate on the same chart, person, area, precision and time window before synthesis.

western.natal.selected_outer.origin: Body bound to a computed tropical natal longitude for this reading.

western.patterns.grand-trine.unknown_if: Unbound body, chart frame or required ephemeris input missing or unstable.

western.patterns.stellium.origin: Group at least three distinct natal planets in one tropical sign, returning one maximal group per sign. Schools also use four planets, house clusters or a chain of conjunctions.
western.patterns.stellium.unknown_if: Unbound body, chart frame or required ephemeris input missing or unstable.

western.patterns.t-square.origin: Two endpoints oppose one another and a third, the apex, squares both. Test all three edges.
western.patterns.t-square.unknown_if: Unbound body, chart frame or required ephemeris input missing or unstable.

western.patterns.yod.origin: Two base planets form a sextile and a third, the apex, forms a quincunx to both. Use the quincunx orb on both long edges; enable quincunx for this search.
western.patterns.yod.unknown_if: Unbound body, chart frame or required ephemeris input missing or unstable.

western.polar-fallback-used.origin: The chosen quadrant system could not produce cusps and the engine explicitly used Whole Sign.

western.progressions.bound-aspect.origin: Aspect of the bound moving body to the fixed natal target under the selected timing method and orb.

western.progressions.secondary-contact.origin: Use birth JD plus elapsed days divided by 365.2425 as the progressed ephemeris JD. Compare the progressed tropical planet to the natal planet within the separate progression orb. The date describes symbolic development.
western.progressions.secondary-contact.unknown_if: Unbound body, chart frame or required ephemeris input missing or unstable.
